apps.short_description: Bend gravity, skate across impossible surfaces, and smash through swarms in GraviSmack, a movement-driven action roguelite. Build a wild mix of weapons and boons, unlock new characters, and fight solo or with friends.

apps.name: Guild of the Tower Demo
apps.short_description: A free demo covering the first ten floors of the tower, where you must send heroes to explore and uncover the true nature of these structures. Naturally, not every hero who ascends returns; death within the tower is permanent (permadeath).

apps.name: Gunsmith's Defense Demo
apps.short_description:
Shoot zombies, collect loot, build your own guns!
Upgrade the persistent metagame to unlock more loot, more features and more parts for your guns.

apps.name: Hacked: The Streamer Demo
apps.short_description: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

apps.name: Headstone Demo
apps.short_description: Try Headstone free: a 3D arcade wave shooter in a moonlit graveyard. As the gravekeeper, hold St. Gloom's churchyard alone against zombies, skeletons, vampires and ghosts, buy a scattergun, and see if you can survive all 25 waves.

apps.name: Heretic's Rapture DEMO
apps.short_description:
Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth.

Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

apps.name: Heroic Musical Chairs Demo
apps.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

apps.name: Hornienfeld: The Oblivion of Nymphilgina Demo
INSIGHT demo
apps.short_description:
Draw lines, and divide a large shape into small shapes.
You need to observe what kind of parts the whole is composed of.
Various symbol rules are waiting for you to explore.

apps.name: Irsen Demo
apps.short_description: IRSEN is a turn-based roguelite where your character fights alone against coordinated enemy squads. Build your hero through a gene system, reshape your abilities mid-run, and endure the growing pressure of corruption.

apps.name: Island Sort Demo
apps.short_description: Bring order to a messy island, one crate at a time. Island Sort is a relaxing sorting game for solo play, 3-player online co-op or 1v1 races. Try the Bakery, the Fruit Stand and the Workshop in this free demo.

apps.name: Janwar Demo
apps.short_description: Janwar is an autobattler roguelike with a focus on tactics. Build your roster, level up your animals and find powerful synergies. Corrupted enemy animals across various biomes will challenge your strategy on the battle grid, where preparation and positioning is key. Can you restore nature's balance?

apps.name: Keyframes Demo
apps.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

apps.name: Kill The Sea Demo
apps.short_description: Sail your way to victory on a deadly campaign across the Seven Seas in a seafaring sandbox survivors-like. Hunt menacing beasts of legend, complete deliveries, win races, defend outposts, find treasures or gamble it all in an oceanic world driven by chaos, risk, and opportunity.

apps.name: Kitty Burger Demo
apps.short_description: Ready for a peaceful day at Kitty Burger? This demo lets you serve warm burgers to purring customers and enjoy a few levels. Full game unlocks more content and continues beyond the demo’s end.

apps.name: Land Reclamation Demo
apps.short_description: Build a path across the sea, one stone at a time. In this free first-person incremental demo, throw rocks, earn points and grow stronger on a realistic coast. Try stone skipping, lift giant rocks and progress toward Mountain Lift or Super Leap.

apps.name: Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel Demo
Lapistasia -ラピスタシア- Demo
apps.short_description:
3-min learn, 100-hour addiction!
Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro.
The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless!
Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

apps.name: Leadwerks Game Engine Trial Version
apps.short_description: Leadwerks Game Engine 5 is an all-new update that makes game development easier than ever. Dive into our video tutorials and learn everything you need to bring your ideas to life. Create with ease using our intuitive visual editor and Lua script. Publish your projects with a royalty-free license.

apps.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing Demo
apps.short_description: Try the first ten waves of Leftovers. Five characters, two co-op modes (The Classic Run and Last Fridge Standing), solo, couch or online for up to four players. Everything you earn carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Living Dead Outbreak Demo
apps.short_description: Battle your way through the dense zombie crowds as you struggle to survive! Inspired by classic zombie movies and FPS games from the 90s, the overwhelming combat will keep you on your toes!

apps.name: Loadout Rush Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of a roguelike where a well-packed bag clears the screen for you. Your weapons fire on their own, so you only decide what goes where. Chicken + Molotov Cocktail + Heart = Dragon. Take the Knight and the Wizard all the way through wave 12.

apps.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner Demo
apps.short_description:
Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories.

How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?

apps.name: Lucky Crafter Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Lucky Crafter, a potion-brewing roguelite on a four-ring wheel. Play all ten rounds of the first tour, Prophecy, including the tutorial. Gems and discovered potions are not saved in the demo. The Vault, Endless Mode and four more tours are in the full game.

apps.name: Lyra Mahjong manager Demo
apps.short_description: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.

apps.name: MachineGunner2 : Bullet Transcending Demo
apps.short_description: MachineGunner 2 is a 2d top-down shooter game that Player controls four characters to clear stages and complete them as fast as possible. This demo contains 3 stages.

apps.name: Magickness Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the Dawn of Magick in this open-world MMORPG demo. Create your character, explore Pangea, gather resources, craft equipment, discover Magick, battle enemies, develop your abilities, and experience the foundations of a persistent online world.

apps.name: Mailed It! Demo
apps.short_description: You're the new night-shift intern at a postal sorting facility. Hit your quota and survive the shift, or build machines to do the work for you. Sorters, fans, conveyors, bizarre contraptions… whatever keeps the mail moving. Because the mail never stops!

apps.name: Mandragora Demo
apps.short_description: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree is an epic dark fantasy action RPG. Play the Demo to experience challenging Soulslike combat, battle a bestiary of monsters, and begin to explore and unravel the secrets of a vast, interconnected world.

apps.name: Manual Teller Machine Demo
apps.short_description:
In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager.
Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise!
Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

apps.name: Medieval Shepherd Demo
apps.short_description: Experience life as a medieval shepherd in this demo. Herd the flock with your loyal dog and protect them from wolves and bandits. Survive through basic crafting and sell your products at the market.

apps.name: Mimic in the Dungeon Demo
apps.short_description: You are the Tentacle Mimic! Build your dungeon and lure female adventurers inside. Recruit them for your harem to harness their energy and grow stronger.

apps.name: MineEngineer Demo
apps.short_description: Build physics-driven ships and automated factories block by block in a 2D space survival sandbox. Mine planets and asteroids, program machines, explore a hostile universe and survive solo or with friends.

apps.name: MobMate WhispTalk – Zero-Cloud Voice Chat Toolkit Demo
Mox Nox Demo
apps.short_description: Parry, dodge and counter a lightning-wielding boss in this standalone Mox Nox demo. Switch sword stances, cast a violet skull and summon a phantom. Includes a replayable boss encounter, sparring practice and Character View.

apps.name: My Mates Demo
apps.short_description: Forget about real-life worries and dive into student life: settle into your rented apartment, keep up with your studies, and, of course, make close friends among your new classmates.

apps.name: MycoRelic Demo
apps.short_description: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten powers.

apps.name: Myriad Gambit Demo
apps.short_description: Try a complete run of Myriad Gambit, a single-player auto battler inspired by Chinese mythology. Choose from four heroes, build a seven-slot formation with four tribes and neutral cards, and face minor bosses and a final trial. Easy difficulty, tiers 1–6.

apps.name: Nightbound Demo
apps.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

apps.name: Noclip: Entity Demo
apps.short_description: Escape the Backrooms, or become the thing everyone is escaping from. One player hunts, seven run: lock doors, swing crowbars and talk your way out of trouble (or into it) in a 1v7 asymmetrical horror party with proximity chat, where every level is new and the exit is never where you left it.

apps.name: Node Pit Demo
apps.short_description: A rogue‑lite, gamble‑style puzzle where you launch catalysts like a Plinko shot inside a starship reactor, activating nodes to charge warp energy. Build powerful nodes through inheritance and card choices!

apps.name: Nullnest Demo
apps.short_description: Defend the Core in a dark tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

apps.name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️ Demo
apps.short_description: Ore Factory Squad Demo is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

apps.name: Outpost Simulator (Demo)
apps.short_description: The world ended. Build a shelter for survivors, serve their needs to earn money, and defend your outpost from raids. Upgrade your base and your gear, and get a taste of rebuilding the wasteland. Welcome to Outpost Simulator DEMO.

apps.name: PAGANS Demo
apps.short_description: PAGANS is a dark-fantasy strategy card game inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses, and warriors, then fight short tactical PvE battles by controlling mystical locations and chaining powerful card synergies.

apps.name: Papaya Plaza Demo
apps.short_description: Rebuild a cute and cozy little tourist town in this laid-back and relaxed slice of life game. Meet adorable villagers, hilarious chickens, and create your perfect little community at your own pace. In this simple sim, you're the mayor and it's up to you. What will you build today?

apps.name: Paresis® II Demo
apps.short_description:
Paresis® II throws you into a twisted supernatural nightmare. As FBI agent David, you must relive your past, solve sinister ritual-like puzzles, fight off grotesque morphs, and conquer brutal bosses.
Survive…if you can.

apps.name: Path of Broken Builds Demo
apps.short_description: The complete first world of Path of Broken Builds: a real-time roguelike where you grow a skill tree while your hero fights on their own. Twenty floors, three mini-bosses, the finale and an endless mode after you win. World 2 is in the full version.

apps.name: Peaceful Days Demo
apps.short_description: Peaceful Days Demo offers tons of fun activities to keep you busy for hours! Take over a cozy local farm in the charming seaside town of Aurora, meet friendly locals, and enjoy your new peaceful life!

apps.name: PERIOD SURVIVAL:Final Trial Demo
apps.short_description:
Heili, The musician who survived the life-or-death variety show "VIAGRA" and won a massive prize,
has once again joined a show where his life on the line!
Want to survive? Then, DANCE!

PERIOD SURVIVAL:Final Trial is a mystery adventure game you find "Varient" participants through dance battle.

apps.name: PETNAROK Demo
apps.short_description: Autobattler animal roguelite inspired by Super Auto Pets & Balatro. Merge animals, apply Fruit & Veggie buffs, and discover powerful synergies.

apps.name: Pixel Gun 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

apps.name: Planet Pilot Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Planet Pilot. Learn to fly over Paris in a guided first flight, take your first jobs, fly through golden Sky Hunt rings and an airshow, then try Dogfights over the Moab canyons: flight school, a boss duel and a Legend battle. Your demo career carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Pregnant Roommates, Send Help! Demo
apps.short_description: A house of five pregnant roommates needs a sixth tenant. You answer the ad. Three weeks ago this was the worst option you had. Now it's where five lives quietly tangle with yours. A slow-burn adult visual novel about chosen family, kept secrets, and dinner at seven.

apps.name: Pro Football Referee Demo
apps.short_description: Pro Football Referee is a football referee simulation game.Start as an unknown grassroots referee and experience the full career of a football official. Officiate matches, make crucial calls, build reputation, and climb the ranks.

apps.name: Project Looking Glass Demo
apps.short_description: 1963. A classified CIA experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

apps.name: Prop Hunt Demo
apps.short_description: Play the Prop Hunt Survivors Demo, a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where Props hide and Hunters hunt. Hide. Hunt. Survive.

apps.name: Proper Football Boss Demo
apps.short_description:
Remember when football was proper?  Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira.

The demo allows you to play one full season. Your save game will be compatible with the full release.

apps.name: Psalm 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Demo version of a first-person psychological horror game in which the elevator is the only safe place. On each floor a new reality. On each floor a new inhabitant. Find him to continue the descent down.

apps.name: Pulsebreaker Demo
apps.short_description: Pulsebreaker is a single-player survival horror game. Manage your scarce resources such as ammo, medicine, and tools to survive.  Skill-based precision tactical combat utilizing headshots, contextual dodges, and melee attacks help beat back the undead. Explore a city teetering on the brink of doom.

apps.name: Querni Demo
apps.short_description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Rank Risk: Guess the Order Demo
RareIcon Demo
apps.short_description: Rareicon is a fast-paced 2D sci-fi Action-RPG bullet-hell roguelite set in a collapsing digital dystopia.Play as Chip, a debt-ridden survivor with WASD + mouse controls, building a sanctuary, upgrading gear, and recruiting allies to fight back against the DaemonCorps, robots, creatures and more!

apps.name: Red Soil Demo
apps.short_description: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

apps.name: Restitched: Wardrobe Demo
apps.short_description: Style and design your own Stuffy! Mix and match cosmetics, decorate unique outfits, and explore community creations in this free preview of Restitched's character customization mode.

apps.name: Retromine Demo
apps.short_description: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend your ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful combos on your way to the bottom of the world. Dig, die, learn, repeat!

apps.name: Rise of Rebellion Demo
apps.short_description:
"Rise of Rebellion" is a 3D action RPG that pursues the tension of confronting strong enemies and sweating in your hands.
People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled.
Survive the battlefield by mastering the deep tactics of melee weapons and the energy "May" derived from the earth.

apps.name: Robologs Demo
apps.short_description: Fight against out-of-control zombie robots! This demo is an early preview of Robologs in development. Gear up, try to survive, and help shape the game with your feedback.

apps.name: School Night Seance Demo
apps.short_description: School Night Séance is a modern take on the point and click adventure genre. A pair of best friends find themselves separated in a haunted mansion after performing an ill-advised séance. Only by working together will they escape the house!

apps.name: SCP - Containment Breach Revival Demo
apps.short_description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

apps.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3 - Single Player Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Check out what awaits you in the game and try the Demo version - grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard!

apps.name: Shuffle Bistro Demo
apps.short_description: Mix menus and build facilities to hit daily revenue goals. Create brand new synergy builds every run with 70+ types of facilities and 4 distinct theme perks in this restaurant deck-building roguelike.

apps.name: Sketchy Fables Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a fully hand-drawn open world full of innocence, until the childlike mind gives way.

apps.name: Slip Angle Demo
apps.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes. In the Slip Angle Demo, try out 6 cars, 3 courses, and multiple game modes and events.

apps.name: Sogni d'Oro Demo
apps.short_description: Sogni d'Oro is a Japanese-style RPG with an Italian flavour.

apps.name: SOS! Love~Controlled Demo
apps.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

apps.name: Soulers Demo
apps.short_description: ‘Soulers’ is a shooter game where you can slow down time to break through bullet hell and assemble a team with various Crew members. Become Lethe, an amnesiac Souler, and face the Witches threatening the world as you seek the truth behind your lost memories.

apps.name: Soulrite Demo
apps.short_description: SOULRITE: a story-driven RPG from the villain’s perspective! Explore a sprawling, unique world, contend with fast-paced gameplay and discover what lies between the twilight of good and evil.

apps.name: Spooky Bodies Demo
apps.short_description: Spooky Bodies is a cozy puzzle game with a ghostly twist. Switch between ghost and human by using traps or possessing bodies. Each form offers unique abilities. Combine them cleverly and interact with the world to solve creative, brain-teasing puzzles.

apps.name: SPRAWL zero Demo
apps.short_description: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

apps.name: Stardeus Demo
apps.short_description: Stardeus is a deep colony sim set on a broken starship manned by drones and hibernating human survivors. As the AI, have your drones repair your ship, save your crew and travel the stars in this beautiful simulation.

apps.name: Story of the Lost Dot Demo
apps.short_description: Discover the classic tale of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland in a whole new way. A gaming experience where you get to feel what it's like to dive inside a novel as a small dot. Roll left and right, rewind time, and venture deeper through the story as you try to find your way back home.

apps.name: Straw Path Demo
apps.short_description: Two months alone in a mountain shack. A locked-away gun. A silent man forced back into a world that stopped waiting for him. Straw Path is a slow-burn survival horror shooter about what it costs to go back outside and what's already found its way in...

apps.name: Streetdog BMX Demo
apps.short_description: Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams in the demo for Streetdog BMX! Explore the Training map, featuring hidden spots, flowing lines, and a set of tutorial challenges to get you started.

apps.name: Tales of Tonbrook Demo
apps.short_description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid.  When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it!  Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

apps.name: TaskBar Gambler Demo
apps.short_description: Try TaskBar Gambler free! A tiny idle slot machine that lives on your taskbar and spins while you work. Every win hits the House. Climb 55 floors, hire a crew and beat the pit bosses.

apps.name: Tempus Triad Demo
apps.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

apps.name: Thanks, Light. Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.

apps.name: The Adventurer's Guide to Another World Demo
apps.short_description: A delightful action adventure set in a mysterious another world! Defeat enemies in satisfying hack-and-slash combat, and explore dungeons filled with puzzles. Combine unique skills and gear to raise the ultimate adventurer and save the continent!

apps.name: The Last Vending Machine Demo
apps.short_description: The world ended. One vending machine is still waiting for power. Crank it to life, sell water, coffee and seeds to survivors, and watch a settlement grow around the only light for miles. A cozy post-apocalyptic incremental game.

apps.name: The MachinEGG Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to The MachinEGG, a relaxing incremental game where eggs are your greatest treasure. Buy chickens, feed them, sell their eggs, and automate your way to retirement!

apps.name: The Planewalker's Guild Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a guild of adventurers through the ruins of the Fallen Keep in this turn-based tactics roguelite. Recruit heroes, spend action points on brutal powers, and decide every step on the road to Blackstone. Every expedition ends in glory or a grave.

apps.name: The Smiling Flesh Demo
apps.short_description: The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where you play as a thief trapped in a decaying gothic mansion. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

apps.name: The Window Across Demo
apps.short_description: Demo: the prologue at the childhood window and the first chapter. A rainy courtyard, the stairwell, a flat where everything is still in its place, and the first shadow puzzle.

apps.name: Tides of Trade: Eastern Horizons Demo
Top of That Thing Called Mountain Demo
apps.short_description: Who would you go with on the toughest adventure? Team up with a friend in this 2-player, 2D co-op platformer and guide two dolphins up an impossible mountain. Shoot harpoons, blast air cannons, and swing your way up. Every climb demands perfect teamwork, and one wrong move sends you both tumbling.

apps.name: Toxoplasma Demo
apps.short_description: You are trapped on an abandoned space station, developing a bio-weapon that makes the infected hallucinate demonic entities. Spot any anomalous signs of infection before they kill you, complete your research, and unmask the conspiracy that brought you here.

apps.name: Trees Hate You Demo
apps.short_description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

apps.name: Trizna Demo
apps.short_description: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

apps.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo
apps.short_description: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo invites you into the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.

apps.name: Tsuki Journey Demo
apps.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

apps.name: Tuned In: The Prologue
apps.short_description: A cursed TV holds you captive. To break free, survive the dark entity's programs of mind-bending puzzles, terror, and impossible choices, as reality and the broadcast slowly bleed into one another.

apps.name: Turning Manor Demo
apps.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

apps.name: VOID/BREAKER Demo
apps.short_description:
🔴 Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS 
Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI.
Escape an endless cycle.
Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding.
Forge deadly synergies.
Carve your way out through enviro destruction
/BREAK THE SYSTEM
/BREAK THE SEQUENCE
/BREAK FREE

apps.name: VRTI - VR Treadmill Interface Demo
apps.short_description: Walk, jog, and run in VR using your real treadmill. VRTI connects your Bluetooth treadmill to VRChat and other games, turning your workout into an adventure.

apps.name: Walter? Demo
apps.short_description: Help a mysterious she-wolf, summoned from the world of the dead, return to her eternal rest. Destroy figures from literature and folklore in turn-based combat through a simple yet brutal memory game.

apps.name: Whispers Of The Crypt Demo
apps.short_description: Whispers of the Crypt is a dark atmospheric RPG set deep beneath a world that’s forgotten its heroes. The Starbound have vanished, yet the forge still burns. You awaken in a lost tomb with no memory, guided by whispers that seem to know your name and your destiny.

apps.name: Who Haunts The Haunters? Demo
apps.short_description: Who Haunts The Haunters? is an East Asian-inspired social deduction game. Purify the mansion as a Ghost, or corrupt it as an Intruder and unleash the Ahgwi Night Hunt. Follow strange sounds, flickering candles, distorted shadows, and suspicious traces to uncover the truth.

apps.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring Demo
apps.short_description: Restore a world consumed by corruption in this roguelite creature collector. Battle enemies alongside mystical Hântu, and combine their powers to unleash devastating attacks. Unlock permanent upgrades aboard your Skyship and grow stronger with every run. From the BAFTA-winning creators of Endling.

apps.name: Witchbound Demo
apps.short_description: Witchbound is a first-person reverse horror game where you play as Callisto Coven, a powerful witch defending her mansion from villagers and priests who seek to destroy the cursed relics binding her to it. Hunt them, terrify them, and become the horror they fear.

apps.name: おとうとクッキング Demo
apps.short_description: A wordplay deckbuilder roguelite where you cook your little brother into steak or meat buns. Rewrite his lines with magic cards and slurp up the magic. Syringes, knives, pickling stones... he may end up as just a head, or a cow. Slurp up a dirty joke, though, and your tools... explode!!

apps.name: ガッチャ！サバイバー Demo
世界第一游戏公司 Demo
apps.short_description: If you love games and never stop pushing forward,then The #1 Game Company is where you belong.

apps.name: 冥界村 Demo
apps.short_description:
Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive.
Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

apps.name: 勇者征途 Demo

apps.short_description: The DLC adds a weapon chest in your safe house. It provides a lot of guns, ammo, and weapon modules to make your journey a lot easier. However, that may kill the fun of tactical thinking in our turn-based combat. and strategically planning before each battle.

apps.name: [Neolithic]Gallery Unlocker DLC
apps.short_description: This is a DLC that will unlock everything in the "Gallery of Memories." (All current ones and future ones)  But, you don't really need to buy it. Everything can be unlocked during your gameplay.

apps.name: Я беременна в 16: Эпизод 2
apps.short_description: "I'm Pregnant at 16: Episode 2" is the continuation of a visual novel about difficult choices. New characters, more branching paths, emotions, and consequences. Help Lida navigate life, growing up, and pregnancy. Experience what it’s like to be pregnant at 16.

apps.name: Я беременна в 16: Эпизод 3
apps.short_description:
After the events of Episode 2, the tension only grows stronger.
Will Lida be able to endure new hardships and cope with her own emotions?
What secrets will come to light, and where will the new choices lead?
Your decisions will once again shape the course of the story.

apps.name: 台北仲夏夜之夢 - DLC
apps.short_description: Chat freely by text with the five original heroines of Taipei Midsummer Night's Dream. With this update, AI replies are generated by a local language model installed on your computer.

You are the CEO of a construction firm. The client signed off on work that was never done, the money is gone, and the trial is ten days away. Three interrogations, a living interrogator, a protocol to sign. One goal — stay out of prison. Inspired by real Article 159 fraud cases.

apps.name: 4x4 in a Furniture Store
apps.short_description: 4x4 off-road physics-based precision driving in a mini open world mega furniture store

apps.name: 5th ERA
apps.short_description: A techno-fantasy JRPG inspired by 16-bit classics. Explore Helgon, the city on the comet, and build your ideal team from a roster of 9 distinct characters, each with their own classes. Engage in strategic turn-based combat against the deadly Brightlings to uncover the truth behind the white portals.

apps.name: 6 Days Out
apps.short_description: A broken leg, a tent on a mountain pass, six nights. By day your friends go out for supplies. At night they walk back to your GPS signal. And something knocks at the entrance. It speaks in their voices and looks exactly like them. Open up or not.

apps.name: 7Years
apps.short_description: Offering a single-player story mode, three unique multiplayer game modes, and even the ability to play as the demons, 7Years is a very different and challenging horror game. With random spawns of demonic enemies, mini games, items, puzzles, and a feline protector, each round is its own story.

apps.name: 8 Days at the Motel
apps.short_description: 8 Days at the Motel is a first-person anomaly horror game. Inspect the motel, memorize your surroundings, and look for anything that has changed. Report DANGER if you spot an anomaly. Report SAFE if everything seems normal.

apps.name: A Demon Hunter's Guide to Passing Finals
apps.short_description: An anime-inspired JRPG where school can be hell—literally. Train at a prestigious demon hunter academy, master powerful magic, battle supernatural threats, forge your own path, and uncover a mystery that could change the fate of the world.

apps.name: A Quiet Place Between Us
apps.short_description: A choice-driven anime romance visual novel about first love, friendship, and letting go. Shape Hina and Kenta’s relationship through branching dialogue, discover three endings, and experience an emotional story with expressive artwork and an original soundtrack.

apps.name: A Rover's Journey
apps.short_description: A Rover's Journey is a 3D, narrative, exploration game, set in space! Play as Roo-ver, and help your astronaut companion discover all the lunar landscape has to offer. Traverse difficult terrain, avoid crashing meteors, and uncover tech from previous expeditions. Can the moon sustain human life?

apps.name: About Frontlines
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

apps.name: Absorber Hero RPG
apps.short_description: Absorb the stats of defeated monsters in this incremental RPG with automatic combat. Build around equipment, relics and monster transformations, uncover hidden areas, and turn each run into lasting progress.

apps.name: Abstract Puzzle Lab
apps.short_description: A relaxing grid-based puzzle game with lots of different tile types and items! Create and play your own custom puzzle levels.

apps.name: Abyss Depth: Control
apps.short_description: A horror point and click set 2000m below the surface. Work off your debt, protect the diver, and survive the abyss—or die trying. In a world drowned by endless water.

apps.name: Abyss Driller: An Incremental Mining Game
apps.short_description: An incremental mining game beneath the ocean. Pilot a drill-equipped submarine, gather ore and turn each haul into permanent upgrades. Fight deep-sea creatures with your spotlight, dodge their attacks and dive deeper.

apps.name: Abyssbound
apps.short_description: A dark 1–4 player co-op dungeon roguelite where an inner voice guides you… or lies. Hunt Abyss Cores through ever-shifting ruins, survive collapsing realms, earn permanent upgrades, and uncover the truth behind the awakening darkness.

apps.name: Aderfall
apps.short_description: Aderfall is a dark third-person action RPG set in a sealed-off mine. Explore a compact, freely explorable world, complete quests, talk to its inhabitants, and battle dangerous creatures. Can you find a way back to the surface?

apps.name: After Hue
apps.short_description: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

apps.name: Alarion The Ruin King
apps.short_description: Alarion: The Ruined King is a dark fantasy action game. A dead king awakens through the power of his own blood and sets out across a demon-infested kingdom. unleash forbidden blood powers, battle deadly enemies and bosses, and face Malachar to end his reign.

apps.name: Alignment Zero
apps.short_description: 'Alignment Zero' is a Real-Time Tactics game with Pause. As the commander of a Private Military Company force, control your troops and complete missions. Build your squad, select equipment, and develop a tactical plan for battle.

apps.name: alter.Cycle
apps.short_description: Not long after a vicious war changed the world forever, a group known as the Deep Magic Scholars are dangerously close to uncovering a secret better kept hidden. The Aspen Isles Mercdom takes it upon themselves to stop them.

apps.name: AMIDA Q
apps.short_description: AMIDA Q is a high-difficulty amidakuji (ladder lottery) puzzle game. Place pieces on the board and guide the balls from the left to their assigned lanes, in the assigned order. New gimmicks keep appearing as you progress, making the board ever more complex. A dynamic, dramatic amidakuji experience.

apps.name: AmongUs Challenger
apps.short_description:
Challenger Games Mod - on Among Us.
Play Ranked / Normal with your friends!
An advanced statistics system (game history, information on player statistics)
Lots of additional roles and content, improved maps and sabotages!
Exclusive and new skins!

apps.name: ANCHOR-13
apps.short_description: ANCHOR-13 is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Wield a unique dual-weapon system and combine cyberware, daemons, and gear to forge powerful decks. Across endless time loops, save your lover, uncover the truth, and bring down the corporation that rules the city.

apps.name: Angel Flare
apps.short_description: Angel Flare is a new approach to aerial shoot’em ups. We have created a shooter with minor RPG elements, such as pilots that affect the Plane controls, different types of planes each with varying attributes, unique upgrades for you plane, weapons and even wingman drones. Yes, in AngelFlare, you can have wingmen that help you fight or protect you. Even these wingmen have upgrades! Angel Flare is all about customization, with hundreds of possible loadouts!

apps.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
apps.short_description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

apps.name: Anomaly Road | 異変車道
apps.short_description:
"Anomaly Road" is an escape game set on a mountain road in Japan, combining horror, driving, and strange occurrences.
While driving, you suddenly realize you've gotten lost on a road deep in the mountains. As you turn a corner with a bad feeling, what awaits you...?

apps.name: Anubis Temple: La Perla de Egipto
apps.short_description: Can you conquer the temple? A highly demanding 2D platformer: a true test of courage. Choose the boy or girl explorer and enter the temple of Anubis, where every jump, every trap and every door hides the secret of La Perla de Egipto.

apps.name: AOYO
apps.short_description:
Welcome to AOYO!

People prefer to call you King.

Your family has sent you to this island as punishment. You must stay at your aunt’s house and explore the island.

apps.name: Ape-tite
apps.short_description: Cook through the chaos in an ape‑paced, local co‑op kitchen where everything almost falls apart.

apps.name: Apprentice Ascending
apps.short_description: Master forbidden magic. Dodge the rent. Survive the Tower. You are an apprentice wizard in a real-time card game brimming with terrible ideas. Pray for coin, study forbidden texts, and climb floor by floor before hunger and the Hunters close in. Seven fates await. Dare to earn the right one.

apps.name: Arcana Rift: Tactics
apps.short_description: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

apps.name: Arcanos One
apps.short_description: Go on a co-op adventure with expressive cars, pull your friends to safety and deal with pesky cops.

apps.name: Are You Cereus?
apps.short_description: Play as Cereus, a mutated bacterium fused with a cereal box, in this absurd 3D adventure platformer. Roll, jump and slide through a hostile suburban home with countless hazards around every corner.

apps.name: ARES
apps.short_description:
ARES is a VR Milsim platform with interactive features, simulated combat scenarios, and customization options. 
Play solo or online with other players in different gamemodes across an open milsim sandbox experience rooted deep in player-driven campaigns missions, & scenarios.
Gear up and embark!

apps.name: Armored clash
apps.short_description: "Armored Clash"isamoderntankbattlegame.You will control the current main battle tanks from various countries and engage in combat with the enemy forces on the battlefieldWehave simplified the complex ballistic calculations, allowing you to focus more on thebattlefieldsituationandfirepowersuppression

apps.name: Aspect Arena
apps.short_description: A siege auto-battler. Buy fighters, arm them, order the line, then watch sixty seconds decide it without you. Fifteen wins takes a campaign, one castle carries every wound it took getting there, and the rival Aspect opposite is building too.

apps.name: ASSAULT SECTOR
apps.short_description: Inspired by old school shooters we grew up with. Built around the PULSE wallhack, expect intense PvP. A throwback to a simpler time. No FOMO or microtransactions. This is our love letter to FPS players who feel ignored.

apps.name: Astral Enterprises
apps.short_description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

apps.name: Astrum Vanguard
apps.short_description: Pilot your ship through 20 waves of alien hordes. Combine auto-firing weapons, evolve their attack patterns through upgrades, and shape your build between waves. Different ships and powerful item synergies open new paths to the final boss.

apps.name: ATMOS
apps.short_description: ATMOS - is a fast-paced action roguelike, where you can shoot, slash, blast, smash, slice, bash and more!.

apps.name: ATSF
apps.short_description: ATSF is an Action-Platformer game with insane focus in player's expression. Explore this huge world, unlocking new powers to fly around and unveil the secrets behind each core Biome.

apps.name: AUM The Game
apps.short_description: Fight real-time multiplayer battles online in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3. Wield five weapons, master the Five Elements, draw on the Three Forces of Creation, Preservation and Dissolution, and grow in body, mind and spirit in the age after the greatest war of an ancient world.

apps.name: AutoBeast Survivors
apps.short_description: Lead a growing pack of animals through alien hordes in a survivors-like with auto-battler strategy. Recruit beasts, merge them to evolve their skills, and stack synergies that play out right on the battlefield. Build your deck, face towering bosses, and turn a small pack into a stampede.

apps.name: Babble Battle
apps.short_description: Those are fighting words! Literally. Use a random supply of letters to create words and put them in offense or defense. May the best vocabulary win.

apps.name: Backwatt
apps.short_description: Backwatt is a co-op top-down action roguelite for 1–4 players. Drop into the arena, fight off waves of enemies and head back to the Barge to gear up. At its heart is your rig: your skill at managing space and planning your purchases decides how strong your build is.

apps.name: BagoLand
apps.short_description: Bagoland is a unique community sandbox built in Unreal Engine 5, driven by Twitch viewers. Claim your plot, build your own space, and see your custom avatar roam the world. Explore, drive, and shape a living world that evolves through collective creativity and community interaction.

apps.name: Baiacool - Tides of Olympus
apps.short_description: Play as a pufferfish who can only say "Cool" in a top-down adventure through an underwater Olympus. Solve puzzles, face gods armed to the fins, and uncover the mystery behind Poseidon’s disappearance.

apps.name: Bait & Bomb
apps.short_description: Catch fish, weaponize them, sink an armada. Fish for your ammunition, then fling swordfish, tortoise, pufferfish and one very annoyed shark at an enemy fleet across 25 voyages of physics artillery, from a small but over-armed fishing boat.

apps.name: Banners & Crowns
apps.short_description: A turn-based medieval strategy game of kingdoms, seasons and diplomacy. Explore the map, grow your cities, research, command armies and heroes, make peace, alliances and royal marriages, and survive the winter. Nine campaign chapters, skirmish on maps up to 30x30 with 8 kingdoms.

apps.name: Bato Battō
apps.short_description: Bato Battō is a 3D platformer-fighter set in classic arena-style multiplayer.  Fight with unique direction based melee combat, athletic movement, and multi-chain combos using stylized physics.  Compete a variety of game modes - Deathmatch, CTF, King of the Hill, Multi-Team and more!

apps.name: Battle Bots Auto Battler
apps.short_description: Build your squad, install powerful upgrades, and watch your machines battle automatically. Survive a 10 round gauntlet, push your build to its limits in Endless Mode, or experiment freely in Sandbox Mode.

apps.name: Battlemap Factory
apps.short_description: Forge complete 3D battlemaps in seconds. Pick a theme, roll a seed, and get a furnished, lit, multi-storey map for your tabletop game. Export it to any virtual tabletop, or play right here with tokens, fog, initiative and dice.

apps.name: Battlemental
apps.short_description: Battlemental is a first-person medieval brawler for up to 8 players. Draft a fresh loadout every round, hack knights apart limb by limb and kick them off crumbling castle towers. No health bars, no mercy: a severed arm makes a perfectly good club.

apps.name: BattleWars
apps.short_description: BattleWars is an in development online casual shooter where you can play how you want on a variety of gamemodes.

apps.name: Beastforger Autobattle
apps.short_description: Forge an army from the monsters you defeat. Build a team of ten, combine Heroic creatures into powerful fusions, and reclaim a fallen kingdom in this fantasy incremental autobattler. Push deeper for better loot, rebuild your citadel, and grow stronger through reincarnation and New Game+.

apps.name: Before the Silence Claims: In Absentia
apps.short_description:
"The truth is not found in what you see… but in what you tune into."
Survive a deceased scientist's memories in a strange 1930s German town. Manipulate frequencies to reveal what is hidden, face unsettling entities, and keep an impossible promise in a tactile, HUD-less psychological survival horror.

apps.name: Beyond the Bars
apps.short_description: Play as a prisoner, guard, or warden. Scheme, trade, and betray, or lock everything down. In this multiplayer social game of control and escape. The prison is yours to use… or break out of.

apps.name: BIODIVIDE
apps.short_description: BIODIVIDE is a first-person survival horror game where you split your body in two and control a living copy of yourself. Explore the blood-soaked halls of Omnivera Hospital, distract enemies, use your surroundings and escape the horror that never stops hunting you.

apps.name: Blood Curse Legions
apps.short_description: This is a  RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

apps.name: Blubbis Abenteuer
apps.short_description: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

apps.name: Bold Hole
apps.short_description: In active Early Access development: unfinished and evolving. Grow a black hole, swallow towers, freeze bullets and chase a fleeing president. Planned to launch at Steam's minimum base-price tier, with price increases as content improves.

apps.name: BOMBACON!
apps.short_description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A BOMB about to explode! BOMBACON! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

apps.name: BOOMEROAD
apps.short_description:
BOOMEROAD is an exhilarating action-adventure game in which players slide along boomerang rails you will create.
The game is set in an ancient ruin floating in the sky, and the player slides through the vast skies at their own will while searching for the Artifacts.

apps.name: Botter
apps.short_description: Define your character: gear, stats, and behaviour, then deploy. Your bot descends procedurally-generated dungeons on its own: fighting, looting, leveling up. Watch it work, gear it better, send it deeper.

apps.name: Bound to Rot
apps.short_description: Play an angel gunslinging down a scorched frontier, the only light the Pulse you gamble on. Gear lives in organs, Rot replaces durability, poker cards craft loot, and one death deletes the vessel. Bound to Rot is an online hardcore Action RPG in a western dark fantasy world.

apps.name: Brain Bomb
apps.short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

apps.name: Branchout
apps.short_description: You're a squirrel, and the clock is running. Sprint along branches, scramble up trunks, swing from ropes and glide through towering treetops. Perfect your moves, keep your momentum and shave off every millisecond. Can you beat the record?

apps.name: Bravebones
apps.short_description:
Bravebones is a stressful anti-stress game.
Shoot arrows. Miss everything. Die. Repeat.
Auto-shoot included (your mouse will thank you).
Short runs, bad decisions, and just one more try.

apps.name: Breachwall: Network Defense
apps.short_description: Defend a growing network against real-world cyberattacks - from a freelancer's home laptop to the quantum era. Place firewalls and 2FA, research new defenses, catch phishing emails, read the logs and decide what to save when everything is under attack.

apps.name: Brunyols
apps.short_description: An online social party game, play minigames and compete versus and collaboratively with other people. Unlock cosmetics and customize your character. Enjoy the moment in company or alone, relax or stress, the choice is yours!

apps.name: BumperMania
apps.short_description: A car crashing arena game with a voxel look that you can play online with friends. Ram the other cars until they fall apart, or push them off the edge. There are all kinds of silly weapons around too. Last car standing wins. You can play PvP or PvE.

apps.name: Bust Out
apps.short_description: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

apps.name: Buy the Dip, Milady
apps.short_description: Let the maids fight. You handle the money! Mine silver, summon maids, and buy or short stocks while battle rages. Your profits might turn the tide. Your losses? Back to the pickaxe. Build your team for story battles, the Endless Tower, and ranked Steam PvP. No paid pulls.

apps.name: Cafe Card
apps.short_description: Cafe Card is a coffee shop game where you prepare drinks and desserts by creating card combinations and serve them to customers.

apps.name: Cave Alchemist
apps.short_description: A wizard cat digs into caves where every pixel is simulated. Lava turns water to steam, acid eats stone, oil burns, crates tumble and bombs blow the world apart. Build spell wands, pick perks, beat bosses and find the portal down - one paw at a time.

apps.name: Celestial Decks
apps.short_description: Life is brief... But death? That's another story. Celestial is a competitive card game where experience is worth its weight in gold. Weave your tale with beautifully illustrated cards. Uncover powerful synergies to claim victory. Follow the paths of the Penumbra, or match wits against other players.

apps.name: Chaos Rune : Heroes
apps.short_description: Chaos Rune: Heroes is a stat-based action game. Can you clear it in the shortest time by positioning yourself, observing enemy positions, and using attacks to one-shot enemies.

apps.name: Charmed Souls
apps.short_description: Take command of Maidenfall Keep and lead your champions into victory! Rescue new champions, upgrade their equipment, complete their quests, and make your way into their hearts, and panties as well!

apps.name: Chat, Should We Head Over There?
apps.short_description: You're the viewer, not the player. SIA, a rookie streamer with ten subscribers, boots up the hit game Backrooms Run for the views - scared, but doing it anyway. Coach her through chat; what she carries out alive makes her stronger. And earlier streamers' records say it's more than a game.

apps.name: Chess Arena
apps.short_description: 40-player real-time chess battle royale on a massive chessboard. Outplay enemies with chess tactics and game-changing ability kits. Master the chaos as the storm closes in to be the last King standing!

apps.name: Choo City
apps.short_description: Lay tracks, flip switches, and dispatch trains to deliver people, coal, and wood to construction sites. Dodge collisions, beat the clock, and build your city one delivery at a time across 24 handcrafted puzzle levels.

apps.name: Chreynard
apps.short_description: Rewind time and control clones to solve intricate puzzles in this innovative 2D action-puzzler. Use your wits and skills to conquer all 30 stages of charming, nostalgic pixel art.

apps.name: Chrono Sword
apps.short_description: Chrono Sword is a somber souls-like action RPG uniquely crafted around time travel. Stepping beyond the limits of pixel graphics, players travel between the past and future to uncover the complicated truths of the destruction of this world, all set within this beautiful, intricately-crafted realm.

apps.name: Circuit Manager
apps.short_description: Manage your own racing circuit. Upgrade its facilities, increase its prestige, attract bigger and better racing series, and deal with everything that can go wrong during a race weekend

apps.name: City Contractor
apps.short_description: Take on construction contracts, control heavy machinery, and watch every project take shape step by step. Earn profits, expand your fleet, and grow your construction company.

apps.name: Claustrum
apps.short_description: Claustrum is an atmospheric first-person exploration game set within an endless brutalist megastructure. Navigate dark industrial corridors, interact with forgotten machinery, and uncover the mystery of a dormant complex that was never meant to wake up.

apps.name: Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer
apps.short_description: Claymation hack n' slash zombie survival horror game set in fantasy world. Team up with your friends, upgrade your arsenal and slash through hordes of zombies to defeat the evil necromancer.

apps.name: Click or Wait
apps.short_description: An idle and clicker game about a machine that is never finished. Build seesaws and mills and let items fall through them: every single piece with real physics. Decide for yourself whether you click, wait or let the machines work. Plus a Teamwork mode with a shared monthly goal.

apps.name: Clicker Astro Planet 2
apps.short_description: Click the planet, do prestige, develop businesses with cats, complete space missions, and unlock 80+ achievements while exploring the galaxy in Clicker Astro Planet 2! Perfect for a 100% completion challenge.

apps.name: Climb Together
apps.short_description: Play solo or stuck with up to 100 friends, explore various worlds and overcome obstacles together. Unlock abilities and checkpoints that aid your journey to uncover the truth and reach the peak in this challenging 3D co-op platformer!

apps.name: Clockwork Maiden M.A.R.Y
apps.short_description: Clockwork Maiden is a 3D Action-Adventure. Play as Mary, a Wind-up Maid fighting to stop the Bell Family from polluting the world. Keep her key wound, upgrade her gadgets, and explore Mansions, smog-choked cities, and airships in a retro PSX-inspired world before time runs out!

apps.name: Cloverstead
apps.short_description: Your grandpa is giving you his old farm! Clean it up, plant vegetables, take care of the animals, and make friends in the small village of Lindenau. Go fishing, explore caves, and help the village fight back against a big scheme from the city. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

apps.name: Coalition Wars
apps.short_description: A turn-based military strategy game inspired by classic territory conquest games. Lead one of two powerful rival coalitions, deploy your tank armies, conquer territories, and use your strategic skills to dominate the battlefield.

apps.name: ColdBurn
apps.short_description:
ColdBurn
Neon-vector arcade shooter where momentum, weapon heat, and split-second decisions keep you alive. Master your drift, perfect your vents, and fight through 7 deadly systems alone or with a second pilot in local, online, or LAN co-op.

apps.name: COREHOLD
apps.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, build a base and descend into dark, procedural caves. Craft weapons, master furnace heat and brew potions, then repair your ship and escape. A top-down pixel adventure where every trip underground brings you closer to home.

apps.name: Corner Loot
apps.short_description: Corner Loot is a clicker game that runs in the corner of your desktop, allowing you to loot chests and accumulate treasures without interrupting your work or browsing. Enjoy a lightweight experience as you progress and earn rewards.

apps.name: Corner TCG
apps.short_description: An idle game that sits in the corner of your screen where you open card packs, sell cards and buy upgrades

apps.name: Cosmo Piercers
apps.short_description: A vertical scrolling shooter where you fire your main shot and strategically switch between limited ammo special weapons to take down enemies. Earn bonus points by clearing areas, and defeat as many enemies as possible before the game ends to achieve a high score.

apps.name: Cozy Moka
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art idle game about a neighborhood café. Serve your first espresso, hire baristas, decorate and grow across the city, from a tiny corner shop to a grand confectionery, one cup at a time.

apps.name: Crimson Banner: War of Liberation
apps.short_description: Ready, comrades? In 'Crimson Banner: War of Liberation', command the PLA, strike the Kuomintang reactionaries, and liberate all China! Turn-based hex wargame, experience every battle!

apps.name: CRIMSON HAREM - My Girls -
apps.short_description: Korea fell to a crimson mist. Left for dead by his former lover, a man leads the Yaksha back to Seoul. Link same-colored tiles in one stroke to fight, then live the story of each woman you meet, part by part. Bond with her, and her power becomes yours. All characters are adults.

apps.name: CUBIC WORLD
apps.short_description: Build miniature worlds from 27 pieces in this 3D puzzle game. Rotate each piece and fit it into place to reveal a beautiful scene. Explore five stages at your own pace, use hints when you need them, and collect completed worlds to revisit anytime.

apps.name: Curatio
apps.short_description:
A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. 

A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

apps.name: Dark Continent
apps.short_description: A fast-paced action MMORPG where every strike is aimed and every dodge matters. Take on epic bosses, experience responsive real-time combat, and enjoy full control—no tab-targeting, no auto-play, and no Pay2Win.

apps.name: DARK PGT 2
apps.short_description: DARK PGT 2 is a dark post-Soviet action game with souls-like elements and black humor. Max Panin wakes up from a coma in a world of mutants, robots, and Soviet experiments. Survive, fight, and figure out who turned everything into this hellish mess.

apps.name: Dead Saints Parade
apps.short_description: A third-person stealth immersive sim. One night inside the Church of Lost Consolation, before its dead saints are carried through the streets at dawn. Read the patrols, stay out of the light, and find out what the Maestro is doing. Two hits kill you. What you know keeps you alive.

apps.name: Deadpact
apps.short_description: Sentenced to death, you're sent into the dark for one last chance at freedom. Solve interconnected puzzles, uncover secrets, face unique enemies with different behaviors, and make choices through dialogue. What you discover and decide will shape your story and determine how it ends.

apps.name: Deadstate Heroes
apps.short_description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

apps.name: Deadstick - Bush Pilot Simulator
apps.short_description: A career-driven bush flight simulator where judgement, skill and reading the terrain determine whether you make a profit. Take on flying jobs across unforgiving wilderness, build crucial infrastructure and earn a reputation among the island's scattered communities.

apps.name: Dear Nobody
apps.short_description: The letters between two pen-pals who have never met cross your censor's desk behind a nameless front. Their romance exists only on paper, so a line you strike is gone from it for good. Partway through, a letter answers a question you only asked in your head. A melancholy epistolary romance.

apps.name: Death by Taxes
apps.short_description:
A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes.
Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

apps.name: Decision Point
apps.short_description: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

apps.name: Deck of Nines
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on a 3x3 tic-tac-toe board. Place cards to chain combos across rows, columns, and diagonals, then draft new cards, stack multipliers, and outscore bosses who cheat the rules to stop you.

apps.name: DEEP FORTRESS
apps.short_description: Assemble war machines part by part, decide where they break, and launch them from your fortress. A single-player tactical autobattler where severed weapon pods keep fighting, raiders flank the enemy fortress, and every wreck is salvage for your next design.

apps.name: Deepvein
apps.short_description: Descend into a persistent mine, extract valuable ores and rare discoveries, manage your tools and cargo, then return to smelt, craft, complete contracts, and expand your operation in this combat-free mining game.

apps.name: Defend The HexCore
apps.short_description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior  |  Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board  |  Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

apps.name: Defend The Nest
apps.short_description: Help two super intelligent crows make silly weapons out of whatever junk they can find in a city park, and then watch them fight off a horde of critters. A relaxing and yet chaotic auto battling roguelike.

apps.name: DEGEN DROOLS
apps.short_description:
An autobattler where degenerate marshmallows fight automatically. Stick them with darts, roast them together, stack them on top of one another for more power, and gamble everything.

THE ONLY THING TO BEWARE IS YOURSELF!

apps.name: Degrees of Love ~ Beyond Eternal Promise ~
apps.short_description:
This is a story about fulfilling a promise made before birth.
A guidepost for the journey home—reclaiming the time lost by fulfilling the promise the two made in the past.
At the end of a journey spanning countless years, with an eternal promise in their hearts.

apps.name: Dice in Wonderland
apps.short_description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Forge every die yourself and stack chips × mult until the Queen's own scorekeeper gives up counting. A cruel, twisted Wonderland under the Cheshire Cat's watchful grin — one more run, all the way down.

apps.name: Digging Up Together
apps.short_description: Dig up the Egyptian desert. Sweep with a metal detector, shovel and drill through the layers in 1–4 player co-op, brush off ancient treasures and real-size dinosaur bones, haul them home by wheelbarrow or minecart, and build your own museum.

apps.name: Dijkstra Order
apps.short_description: You cross paths with an unknown entity. With a modified anti-materiel rifle and sawed-off, parry their attacks to the beat in DIJKSTRA ORDER.

apps.name: Divinestead
apps.short_description: Grow one small village into a large settlement, manage resources, find riches, overpower enemies and get holy upgrades in this incremental idler game!

apps.name: Do A Kickflip
apps.short_description: Skate an endless city that builds itself as you ride. Flip, grab and grind across three lanes of street, chain tricks into huge combos, and ride from sunset into midnight. One more run is always one kickflip away.

apps.name: Docked Realms
apps.short_description: A semi-idle auto-battler drawn from Sumerian myth: bind ancient souls and hold a strip torn from the laws of the gods. Lugal, Gula and Erra fight on their own, even while you are away. You choose the line, the relics and the moment to step in.

apps.name: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War
apps.short_description: The year is 2083. As the galactic space pirate crisis reaches its breaking point, you—a "dog of the military"—must pilot a humanoid Powered Metal Frame (MF), subdue rival captains, unite them under your banner, and emerge victorious in the ultimate Pirate War!

apps.name: Don't Drain The Lake
apps.short_description: Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake. A cozy first-person incremental about emptying a mountain reservoir by bucket, pump and siphon, while the sun follows the water down and the valley gives back what it kept.

apps.name: Don't Stop the Beat
apps.short_description:
**Red Light, Green Light at the Club!**

Dance, blend in with NPCs, and take down the DJ!

DON'T STOP THE BEAT! is an asymmetrical multiplayer TPS. The DJ team must finish the track, while the Gang team blends in with dancing NPCs to take down the DJ!

Dance, blend in, and shoot to win!

apps.name: DORII —stairway to heaven—
apps.short_description: Torii makes his living illegally cloning humans. A single request—and a single life—begin to change his isolated world underground. An unsettling yet poignant psychological horror visual novel about what it means to be human, and what remains beyond.

apps.name: Dream Ocean
apps.short_description: A story-driven JRPG combining turn-based party battles with tactical combat. Mix skills across classes, follow your companions’ stories, and explore hidden dungeons on a journey from a city of endless night to strange worlds above the ocean.

apps.name: Drilling Down Under
apps.short_description: A co-op drilling game in the Australian outback for up to four mates. Run the rig, sell the ore, buy a bigger one, then lose your pay at the pub. Mind the kangaroos.

apps.name: Dungeons of Shalnor: The New Age
apps.short_description: An old-school first-person dark fantasy CRPG. Create your own character with a unique set of skills. Explore the world and delve into perilous dungeons, equip yourself with powerful weapons and armor, and unravel the deceptive schemes of the Gorgon Queen.

apps.name: Dusk Lord Online
apps.short_description: A free medieval fantasy MMORPG in one persistent shared world. Found a guild and put your people to work, trade in a market that turns with the seasons, delve into generated dungeons, and march your army across the map to besiege rival guild halls.

apps.name: Dust & Diamonds
apps.short_description: Humans are extinct, and Goblins proudly stand at the top of the food chain! Take over a mine, expand your surface base, and automate logistics. Manage workers, trade, avoid cave-ins and lava, and above all – try to endure your father's constant grumbling!

apps.name: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
apps.short_description: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.

apps.name: Dwarf Titan: Song of the Gold Eaters
apps.short_description: You are a Gold Eater dwarf the size of a rabbit. Mine, slay, loot, and eat gold to grow, coin by coin, into a titan big enough to swallow the sun god who cursed you. A 2D sandbox where your size changes everything, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Earthia Mining
apps.short_description: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.

apps.name: Echo of God
apps.short_description:
A world of discovery, existing in perfect harmony, broken from the destructive powers of Chaos.
Explore lush forests, battle chaotic monsters, make friends and memories, and power yourself up for a big adventure, while still being silly.

apps.name: EDGE-FI
apps.short_description: Don’t rush to figure out what’s going on in a place the world has discarded, where dim neon flickers through the haze. Discover how the devices around you work, and lose yourself in atmospheric music as you bring the city back to life. So, when progress moves on without us, where do we belong?

apps.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
apps.short_description: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

apps.name: Endless Corridors
apps.short_description: You're not alone in here. Something crawls the ceilings above you, listening for every step. The building rebuilds itself every run, the lights fail without warning, and there is only one way out. Find it before it finds you.

apps.name: Endless Void: Idle Tower Defence
apps.short_description: Shoot. Upgrade. Die. Repeat. Defend against endless swarms in this minimalist idle tower defense. Construct an impenetrable fortress, research game-breaking tech, craft legendary gear, and harness cosmic abilities like Black Holes and Orbital Strikes. How deep into the Void can you survive?

apps.name: EPIBDA
apps.short_description: Iceland, October 1989. For seven nights you keep the light on a remote lighthouse. Out in the fog stands EPIBDA, a thing 120 metres tall. It moves only when no one is looking. Keep the beam on it, guide the ships past the reef, and don't let the lamp run dry.

apps.name: Erevael
apps.short_description: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.

apps.name: Eternal Fracture
apps.short_description: In Eternal Fracture, you play as officer T. A grieving police officer that gets dispatched to the Bayou Mall in Louisiana to reset a known malfunctioning security system. What was supposed to be just another late-night routine sweep turns into dread. You are being watched.

apps.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
apps.short_description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

apps.name: Everbond
apps.short_description: A cursed notebook. A brush. Everything you draw comes to life and fights for you. Build your team stroke by stroke in this auto-battler roguelike… and find out why you can’t leave.

apps.name: EverDarkly: Beloved
apps.short_description: A top-down 2.5D space roguelite. Salvage the bones of a war nobody talks about. Loot rolls, adrenaline charges with chaos, death sends you back to the Cradle. Your AI companion Luna keeps the silence company. Something out there is waiting for you to get good enough.

apps.name: Everhex
apps.short_description: Build one tower. Hold endless waves. Spend what each wave drops on damage, crit and six weapon mounts firing at once — then bank the run into a 453-node passive tree that carries into the next. A premium incremental tower defence: no ads, no timers, no energy bars.

apps.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
apps.short_description: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

apps.name: Expendable Drillers
apps.short_description: Dig a mining base deep under Mars and keep its hapless crew alive. Feed them, bed them, give them air and fix the machines before the rooms fall in. Simple to start, deep to master, and full of cartoon mishaps.

apps.name: Factory Time
apps.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

apps.name: False God
apps.short_description: Dive into your psyche again and again. What began as a quest to save your sister devolves into a fight for your soul in this story-rich adventure. Unearth forbidden lore, decipher hidden clues, and outwit cosmic entities as you explore a world blending Chinese folk horror with Lovecraftian horror.

apps.name: Falt
apps.short_description: The city fell in 72 hours. You have one night. Scavenge, build, endure and fight through a quarantined open-world city where every noise draws the horde. Solo survival at launch, with online co-op and PvP servers planned for future updates.

apps.name: Final Night At Hotel
apps.short_description: Together, you must investigate the creature haunting the hotel, collect clues, and vote each night for determine the strategy to defeat it. When night falls, your goal is clear: kill or exorcise the creature... Horror game for up to 5 players

apps.name: Find The Gold
apps.short_description: A mountain of sand. Gold hidden somewhere inside. Dig, haul and sell your first loads, then build the machines that take over the hard work. Connect conveyors, power a growing factory and uncover natural gold specimens in a first-person digging and automation game.

apps.name: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
apps.short_description: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring over 40 fishing destinations and 260 fish to discover. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

apps.name: Flock Fight
apps.short_description: A minimalist couch fighting game with a twist: you are a flock of health units. Balance offense and defense as you use weapons to survive quick match ups online or locally.

apps.name: Flutterfield
apps.short_description: Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

apps.name: FluxShot
apps.short_description: The fast-paced free multiplayer FPS where abilities are your lives. Choose three, arrange their order, and switch to the next every time you die. Lose them all, and you’re out.

apps.name: Foodgitives
apps.short_description: Foodgitives is a 1-4 player couch co-op arcade game where you're food on the run. Tilt and roll through restaurants where murderous utensils attack to the beat of 1930s big band jazz. Wrestle with your friends for control of the tilt, or master it alone.

apps.name: Forester
apps.short_description: Atmospheric forest management game about rebuilding a neglected woodland estate, mastering the care of the land, and finding your place among its inhabitants. Plant, cut and cultivate trees, restore your homestead, and shape the life of the one who tends it.

apps.name: Formula First Manager
apps.short_description: Take on the role of a Team Principal and build your career in a living paddock. Recruit, develop your car, negotiate, manage your team and face the consequences of your decisions across multiple seasons.

apps.name: Forsaken Shadows
