apps.short_description: A short circuit pulls you into your own game console. You wake up as a robot, standing in fragments of the games you own, and work through them to get home. One inventory, one character, everywhere. Death costs the trip back, never your loot.

apps.name: Fox in a Field
apps.short_description: In this fresh new take on the classic Minesweeper, cross the field one step at a time. Find your babies on the way to the exit. Move around obstacles and find hidden objects in the field too! If you ever enjoyed mine sweeper you will love my game. Choose quick play or Quest through 100 levels

apps.name: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
apps.short_description: Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

apps.name: Frame 343
apps.short_description: At a small data recovery firm you restore the camera of a man missing since 2011, at his sister's request. File 343 is missing. Dark records appear only while you hold Develop. But the camera is looking for a face, and when it finds one, it shoots. Short horror built on real photos and timestamps.

apps.name: FreeSurf
apps.short_description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

apps.name: Fruit Auto Fighters
apps.short_description: In this auto battler, every fruit on your team is slowly rotting. Draft a squad, arm them with weapons, and compost the spoiled ones into fertilizer for whoever's left. Then send them out to fight teams built by real players.

apps.name: Fuse Rush
apps.short_description: Fuse Rush is a fast-paced physics action game inspired by the N64 classic Blast Corps! Grab bombs and objects, charge your throw power, and clear obstacles. Earn rewards, unlock cool skins in the shop, and beat the highscore before time runs out!

apps.name: Garbage Collector
apps.short_description: The city is full of trash… but what secrets lie hidden among the garbage? Hit the streets at sunrise, collect waste, and uncover the city’s forgotten mysteries! Upgrade your tools over time, collect faster, and progress on your trash-collecting journey!

apps.name: Gatefall: Rise of the Last Knight
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy action game where reality is shattered by mysterious gates, revealing a corrupted world. As the last knight, you are the town’s only remaining hope for uncovering the truth behind its downfall.

apps.name: GAY IT LOUD
apps.short_description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

apps.name: Gembound
apps.short_description: Roguelite match-3 RPG where the board is dealt from your gem satchel. Build your deck, match gems, and cast spells.

apps.name: Get On Board!
apps.short_description: Run a boat tour with your crew! Set sail with passengers, keep the wheel steady, and navigate rough waters without mixing up orders. Complete the voyage without capsizing and become Amalfi's top tour agency.

apps.name: GhostomVillage
apps.short_description:
Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive.
Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

apps.name: Gingar Ail Demo
apps.short_description: Step into the shoes of a witch disguised as a student for one semester. In this heart-stealing visual novel RPG, build relationships with seven unique characters and decide whose heart you’ll claim… or who might just steal yours.

apps.name: Globus
apps.short_description: Explore the world on an interactive 3D globe and test your geography knowledge across countries, capitals, flags, landmarks, mountains, rivers, seas and more. Play in TYPE, SELECT, GUESS or HINT modes and improve your skills round by round.

apps.name: Glow Arcade Racer
apps.short_description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

apps.name: GOD OF DEFIANCE
apps.short_description: A Journey to the West deckbuilder with shadow-puppet art and mahjong-powered combat. Choose your fighter, build card and relic combinations, read enemy intentions and take branching routes through a ten-chapter single-player expedition.

apps.name: Going Up?
apps.short_description: Going Up? is a 1-4 player online co-op horror-comedy, with bots for any empty seat. Ride a billionaire's elevator to floor 100, take turns choosing the floor, and get 60 seconds at every stop to grab loot and dive back in before the doors close. Every monster has one rule. Learn it fast.

apps.name: Gravity Switch
apps.short_description: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

apps.name: Greenfire
apps.short_description: Greenfire is a turn-based 3D tank artillery game where every shot reshapes the battlefield. Master wild weapons, trigger chain reactions, outsmart AI rivals, and take on a punishing 20-round campaign—or experiment freely in the shooting range.

apps.name: Grid Beasts
apps.short_description: Recruit unusual creatures, master their movement patterns, and build a team that changes the battlefield. Grid Beasts is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you evolve and fuse companions, brave branching routes, and bring survivors home for your next expedition.

apps.name: Grid Demon
apps.short_description: Hack the swarm and build your army in this cyberpunk bullet-heaven roguelite. Turn enemy machines into allies, shape your build, and unleash a surge of power as you battle the Wardens across five hostile grids. Free the Grid, or claim it for yourself.

apps.name: Grimmarch
apps.short_description: A dark folk-horror card RPG. Walk a story campaign across a dying borderland, make hard choices for the people who stayed, and win card battles by outguessing enemies who play at the same moment you do. Grow your hero with new cards, talents and levels. Play solo or with up to four friends.

apps.name: Grindset T.V.
apps.short_description: Grindset T.V. is an open world speedrunning first person platformer for the freaks. God is dead, and Heaven has gone corporate. You’re a gig worker hivemind engineered for package delivery. Welcome to Heaven. Watch your step.

apps.name: Grizzly Cup: Tour de Mondo
apps.short_description: Represent your country in a retro top-down arcade racer for up to 16 players online. Customise your car and driver, fly your flag, and race for the podium. Play solo, compete in Cups, and build your own tracks.

apps.name: Guild Master
apps.short_description: An old-school RPG where you run the whole guild solo or with friends. Gather, craft, farm, fight, loot and explore with a growing crew. Switch heroes while the others keep working, turn shared supplies into better gear, and prepare your adventurers to face a deadly fire-breathing dragon.

apps.name: Guild of the Tower
apps.short_description: A party-based RPG where you build a guild, program your heroes' battle tactics with the Gambit system, and send them climbing into a mysterious tower where permadeath is real and not everyone comes back down.

apps.name: Hack The Stars
apps.short_description: A tactical cyberpunk MMO where you infiltrate networks through real-time hex-grid combat, managing CPU, Heat, and Bandwidth. No classes. No levels. Progression through hardware limits. Hack megacorps, crash economies, and uncover your erased past across a persistent galaxy.

apps.name: Halve
apps.short_description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

apps.name: Hamster Time
apps.short_description: Your desktop hamsters run on their wheels in response to your keyboard and mouse input. Get things done with friends while collecting cute hamsters and stylish wheels. Enjoy a variety of multiplayer modes, plus a timer and to-do list.

apps.name: Hantu and Hunted
apps.short_description: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

apps.name: Hayloop
apps.short_description: A cozy farming and ranching sim where you grow a small plot into a thriving agricultural business. Plant and tend crops, raise animals, keep bees, process your harvest into valuable goods, open your shop, and automate your farm as it grows, all on your way to breeding prized horses.

apps.name: Healing For Dummies
apps.short_description:
Healing For Dummies is a 2D "MMO-like Healing Boss-Rush Simulator". Keep your party alive while also learning how to survive all the things bosses throw at you.
Master your class and bosses while becoming a better healer!

apps.name: Heart Of Slav
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy game on a hex map steeped in Slavic folklore. Build a settlement, gather the land's resources, buy cards with gold won in battle, and lead units against the Devil.

apps.name: Hellbinder: Shibari Secrets
apps.short_description: Master Shibari, the authentic Japanese erotic art of rope bondage in this adult game! Play a demon tasked by an angel to perform sacred exorcisms on 8 customizable succubi. Featuring deep character customization and multiple game modes, can you subdue these seductive temptresses?

apps.name: Heretic's Fork - RAPTURE
apps.short_description:
Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth.

Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

apps.name: Hexa Fighters
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical PvP game where every tile, every action point, and every ability matters. Create your builds, combine abilities, control the map, and face other players in strategic 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 battles.

apps.name: Hidden Chess
apps.short_description: Every piece hides its true identity until it first moves. Play Hidden Chess, a bluffing twist on chess, against 6 levels of AI or friends and rivals online. Classic Chess is included too.

apps.name: Highschool J
apps.short_description: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.

apps.name: Hking's Block Arena
apps.short_description: Up to twelve cube robots, one grid, one shot then reload. A couch-first party shooter: Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, King of the Hill, Juggernaut and Gun Game - up to 8 players on one screen, online with friends over Steam, or against bots.

apps.name: Hokm: Card Game of Kings
apps.short_description: Hokm is Iran's classic trick-taking card game for four players in two partnerships, painted like the coffeehouse pictures of the Shahnameh. Call the trump, follow suit, take seven tricks. Play online, on your own network with friends, or alone against the bots.

apps.name: Holiday Alliance
apps.short_description: Stop Santa's hordes from taking over the Holiday Lands in this festive, fun Tower Defense game.  Drop roman candles, sparklers, snowblowers and deploy heroes to hold the line across a storybook campaign.

apps.name: Homunculeye: Seer’s Ascent
apps.short_description:
Climb a merciless ascent where every mistake sends you falling.
In this brutal rage-platformer, claim the power of those who stand in your way to discover the truth.

apps.name: Horny Dungeon
apps.short_description: Horny Dungeon is an NSFW roguelite turn-based RPG. Lead a team of captivating heroines, conquer dungeons and loot all the precious relics. Yet, the real treasures lie in the relationships you build along the way. And of course, they go beyond platonic...

apps.name: Hotel Simulator
apps.short_description: Take control of a motel in Winston Springs! Design unique interiors, care for guests, earn and invest in a hotel network. Plan room layouts and furnishings, and hire staff. Transform outdated spaces into luxurious apartments with attention to every detail. Will you create the hotel of your dreams?

apps.name: How They Built the Pyramids
apps.short_description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

apps.name: Hyogoslavia Chronicles
apps.short_description: A classic turn-based JRPG set in five rival nations inspired by Hyogo, Japan (home of Kobe). Guide a hesitant prince through a land where every nation has its own idea of justice, explore far and wide, and find your way to the true ending. Fully playable in English.

apps.name: Ikigai
apps.short_description: Grab, shove and flail your way through a gauntlet of physics-driven party games. Up to 8 players, wobbly ragdoll limbs and a fresh minigame every round — sumo showdowns, chaotic football and frantic fishing, wrapped in Japanese folk charm.

apps.name: In the Same Boat
apps.short_description: Embark on an adventure across the ocean! In this captivating cooperative sailing game, one player commands the ship, while the other is confined to the captain's cabin, solely navigating with the map. Successfully completing your missions will require the crew's adept communication and skill.

apps.name: IncreGate
apps.short_description: IncreGate is an incremental shooter. Hold the line as hundreds of goblins, skeletons and orcs pour out of a dimensional gate, then spend the shards on a sprawling upgrade tree, six guns, weapon parts and a ten-strong fireteam — and push one wave further.

apps.name: Incremental Magic
apps.short_description: A 2D action clicker where you click, drag, and scroll to hunt monsters yourself with your mouse. Aim your skills to break the bosses of 8 dungeons, and grow your skill tree into a build of your own. Not idle — aim, shoot, smash.

apps.name: Indeterminate
apps.short_description: A scare-your-friends asymmetrical horror game where one of you is the indeterminate. Survivors gather evidence to work out what it is and banish it with a ritual, while the indeterminate turns anomalies, traps and jump scares against them, or catches them off guard and kills them.

apps.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together
apps.short_description: Infinite Einstein Tiles Together is an online cooperative jigsaw puzzle game featuring the true einstein tile. Up to 8 players can piece together a single puzzle side by side.

apps.name: Infinite Einstein Tiles3
apps.short_description: Infinite Einstein Tiles3 is a casual puzzle game based on the "true einstein tile" discovered by David Smith and his colleagues.

apps.name: INKLINE: Erased Lines
apps.short_description: Your desktop is more than a screen — a world waiting to be drawn. Sketch bridges, raise walls and set traps with your mouse in this hand-drawn action platformer. Battle ink-born monsters, explore chapters and face bosses as an adventure comes alive above your taskbar.

apps.name: Inkwell Cove
apps.short_description: Explore a vibrant ocean paradise, raise and customize adorable Octos, discover hidden treasures, and compete in races, battles, and minigames as you build the ultimate underwater pet collection.

apps.name: Intercept Course
apps.short_description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

apps.name: Investors Paradise
apps.short_description: Build your own financial empire in this business and investment simulation. Trade stocks, rent out properties, invest in start-ups, acquire collectibles at auction, and establish your own company—rising from a small-time investor to the greatest investor in history.

apps.name: Iron Dogs
apps.short_description: In Iron Dogs, take the helm of 1940's inspired aircraft in a colorful retro-inspired arcade flight-sim where you will blast hordes of enemy aircraft, naval vessels and more! Engage in dogfights (literally) with hostile aircraft, while flying through beautifully hand-crafted environments.

apps.name: Irondrive
apps.short_description: Your base is on the move. Your crew is at the breaking point. Manage priorities, automate repairs, and keep everyone alive as your fortress crosses a hostile wasteland. Survive the attacks. Adapt to the chaos. Keep moving.

apps.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles
apps.short_description: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles is a real-time strategy game about conquering medieval islands. Grow your kingdom, raise armies, capture regions, and command entire forces. Plan your expansion, reinforce key positions, and choose the right moment to strike.

apps.name: Irsen
apps.short_description:
IRSEN is a turn-based roguelite where you fight alone against coordinated enemy squads - progression does not come from traditional XP, gold, or gear.
Defeat enemy groups, extract their genes, rebuild your body, reshape your skills, and adapt your strategy during each run.

apps.name: Island Sort
apps.short_description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

apps.name: Isle Goblin
apps.short_description: Build, explore, fight and rescue your goblin family from the human invaders in a sandbox survival adventure game. Play solo or with up to 7 friends as you rebuild your town, craft powerful gear, explore dungeons, mine rare resources, salvage human treasure, and befriend your goblin neighbours

apps.name: Jeremy is Broke
apps.short_description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

apps.name: Jewel Reels
apps.short_description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

apps.name: Jinx It
apps.short_description: Jinx It is a roguelike dicebuilder where every die has a trick. Arrange rolls into Straights and Sets, reshape your dice at the Forge, stack Lucky Charms, and face those who lost everything to Jinx, the Unlucky One, as you turn your bad luck into a broken build.

apps.name: JobLoop
apps.short_description: Job Loop is a single-player RPG inspired by the absurdity of corporate life. Unravel a dark conspiracy with your cute robot sidekick. Make tough choices and take sides. Become the dream job candidate or completely destroy the company you're applying to.

apps.name: Joshua: Door to Dreams
apps.short_description: Welcome to Joshua’s World, a top-down ARPG where you can wield more than 10 different weapons, harness four elemental powers, use your combat techniques to battle a wide variety of formidable enemies, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the mysteries behind two interconnected worlds.

apps.name: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979
apps.short_description: The world ended and the madness began. As Max, survive a brutal, radioactive wasteland to save your kidnapped daughter from a ruthless gang. Fight radiation, explore a dangerous open world in 1st/3rd person, and make choices that shape your destiny in this dark RPG survival.

apps.name: K.H.L.E.E
apps.short_description: Retro roguelike deckbuilder meets corporate dystopia. In 1982, AGI runs the world, you're just a cog. Log into your K.H.L.E.E. terminal, arrange tiles to meet shifting quotas, and survive the week. Fail once - your profile is wiped. Endless candidates are waiting.

apps.name: Keep the night
apps.short_description: Build your fortress by day and defend it by night. Construct walls, recruit troops, draw powerful cards, and lead your hero into battle against ever-growing enemy armies.

apps.name: Keyboard Warriors
apps.short_description: Keyboard Warriors is a bullet-heaven roguelite typing game, customise your mech and weapon loadout and type out the story of the world to cut down huge hordes of enemies and bosses, powering up with each victory and unlocking new upgrades with every run.

apps.name: KILLNETIC
apps.short_description: KILLNETIC is a multiplayer-only movement shooter. Slide, dash, wall run and slam around gothic steampunk arenas, earn weapon ultimates, and hear nearby players over proximity chat.

apps.name: Kingdom Blackjack
apps.short_description: Kingdom Blackjack. Use blackjack to earn money for your kingdom, and hire mercenaries to defend it. Win funds at the blackjack table to withstand enemy attacks.

apps.name: Ko-Archie: Eeny Meeny Miny Moe
apps.short_description:
Throw Boomerang like a legend and shoot Pistol with John Wick precision in this immersive VR game.
Face relentless combat waves, tackle powerful enemy bosses, solve puzzles, and stay alive by managing your hunger and thirst as you race against time.

apps.name: Komorebi Slime Ranch
apps.short_description: Pet slimes, gather materials, and let your ranch do the work. Raise six slime species, automate feeding and shipping, and fulfill town orders in this cozy incremental game. Rebirth unlocks lasting upgrades as you grow across four ranches.

apps.name: Koto the Runner
apps.short_description: Let your heart overflow! Koto the Runner is a rhythm game where you run to the beat of the music to save a fantasy world, overcome your past trauma, and save your cat. Get out there, find your groove, and learn to fight the power.

apps.name: Kyua　創作の治療
apps.short_description: This game is a metafiction RPG set in a virtual game world. Due to the nature of this setting, there are some ambiguous depictions throughout the game; however, since the characters have all come to terms with this, we ask that players proceed with this understanding.

apps.name: Lanelord
apps.short_description:
You ever wanted to feel how a road feels? Now you can!
Either team up with a car or try to shake it of. Solo and Multiplayer fun guaranteed!

apps.name: Last Dispatch
apps.short_description: Keep the last post office lit with your feathered postal companion. Rotate conveyor belts, switch routes and plan waiting times across 100 puzzles in 12 chapters. Coordinate gates, delivery orders and simultaneous arrivals. No real-time countdown—think, rewind and retry at your own pace.

apps.name: Lastrip
apps.short_description: A girl and a vampire travel through a frozen world in this post-apocalyptic yuri visual novel. Read from Mei's perspective as she heads toward Huangshan, meets other survivors, and grows closer to the stranger who offered her a hand in the snow.

apps.name: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES
apps.short_description: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

apps.name: Let Me Die
apps.short_description: You're trapped by a monster! Hit it, collect gems and coins, buy upgrades, watch numbers go up. Until you're strong enough to escape.

apps.name: Light Hunters: Journey
apps.short_description: Command two hunters of light against waves of creatures that strike all at once. Every kill buys you precious seconds: chain combos, unleash your skills, collect spirits and unlock permanent upgrades before the timer runs out.

apps.name: LightSup!
apps.short_description: LightSup is a chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op adventure where darkness drains sanity while the Altar of Light keeps you alive. Battle monsters, gain powerful Blessings, endure dangerous Curses, and choose your path to save the world from an eternal eclipse.

apps.name: LINETAIN
apps.short_description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

apps.name: Linkominoes
apps.short_description: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game where overlapping squares form connected structures. Unwind with the satisfaction of placing pieces and building patterns, or take on unique challenges that put spatial planning and strategy to the test.

apps.name: Little Mage
apps.short_description: Little Mage is an action-packed 2D Metroidvania where you play as an Æther Mage in a beautifully hand-drawn, high fantasy world. Explore the shattered city of Hornedrose, unleash elemental magic, battle fearsome bosses, and uncover the secrets of a world on the brink of destruction.

apps.name: Livingston County
apps.short_description: The dead fill the streets of Howell, Michigan. Search houses for food, haul supplies home, and board up before dark. Build a base and keep a few people alive in an isometric zombie survival sandbox.

apps.name: Loadout Rush
apps.short_description: Build the perfect loadout — before the wave hits. Cram items into a grid backpack, buff them with neighbor synergies, and merge them into something greater. Chicken + Molotov + Heart = Dragon. We had rules. It happened anyway. Monster waves are coming, and your bag IS your weapon.

apps.name: LockDown Dom
apps.short_description: A visual novel where you can either dominate or submit to the love interests.

apps.name: Look-Book-Worm!
apps.short_description: Look-Book-Worm! is a team vs team co-op game. Players are divided into 2 groups: moles and worms. Each team's goal is to fill score line in its favor by doing different tasks.

apps.name: Lost Liminal
apps.short_description: "Descend into liminal space—evade lurking horrors, solve cryptic puzzles, and use your camera to preserve the memories you leave behind in this eerie world. Switch to night vision to uncover hidden clues and trace what's amiss. This first-person indie horror will keep you guessing at every turn."

apps.name: Lost Soul
apps.short_description: A nameless skeleton awakens in a graveyard. To recover lost memories and uncover the truth, it embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: Lot Luck
apps.short_description: Open mystery boxes, discover hundreds of unique items, and find out what they're worth. Sell your finds or grow your collection, upgrade and automate your business, and collect adorable cats. What will the next box reveal?

apps.name: LouLan
apps.short_description: Loulan Kingdom blends survival city-building with real-time strategy. As the ruler of Loulan, build your city in a procedurally generated desert oasis, prosper through trade along the Silk Road, and fight with all you have to defend your kingdom until the very end.

apps.name: Love, in Debt!?
apps.short_description: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
developers: 华东理工大学创客空间

apps.name: Lowlands Conquest
apps.short_description: The orc and undead camps are spreading across your land, threatening to overrun everything in their path. As their numbers grow, so does their power. It’s up to you to lead the charge and wipe them out before it's too late.

apps.name: Lucky Flash
apps.short_description: A visual novel/game about Michael "Lucky Flash" Foster — a university student and part-time courier whose daily deliveries turn into memorable adventures.

apps.name: Lunar Wardens
apps.short_description: Build a team of elemental creatures and fight for the league title with up to 8 friends. Hire, hunt and evolve your creatures between matches, then set your line-up and watch every bout play out live in the moonlit arena.

apps.name: Magic Quest: TCG
apps.short_description: Magic Quest: TCG is a fantasy themed collectable card game with 11 different classes to choose from, a world to explore with hundreds of Stages, competitive PvP, Dungeons and Raids which you can play solo or with your guildmates.

apps.name: Magitech Mecha: Requiem of the Azure Flame
apps.short_description: A philosophical, character-driven sci-fi adventure blending visual novel storytelling, dungeon exploration, and turn-based combat. Play as Adrian, a legendary mercenary. Pilot a Mana Mecha into uncharted Rifts, meet people on other paths, and witness civilizations collide as the old order falls...

apps.name: Manual Teller Machine
apps.short_description:
In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager.
Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise!
Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

apps.name: Marrowlight
apps.short_description: Seven women are chained beneath the world, holding an apocalypse down. You are the Warden sworn to execute them when they fail. Free them instead. A horde-survival roguelite where every character you unlock is someone you were sent to kill.

apps.name: Math Defense Protocol
apps.short_description: Deploy characters across a fractured mind, combine numbers and operators into equations, and turn every result into firepower. Build your squad, trigger bonds, and defend the last memories through story battles and endless challenges.
developers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio
publishers: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

apps.name: Merchant Legends: The Founding
apps.short_description: Build a new town in a Game Boy inspired fantasy world... Gather resources, recruit citizens, trade goods and grow your empire to push back the forces of evil! A love-letter to retro RPGs.

apps.name: MillionCube
apps.short_description: Million Cube is a maze exploration game with multiplayer for up to 30 players. Find the one correct room among up to a million rooms by following clues hidden in the writing on the doors and the surrounding scenery!

apps.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
apps.short_description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

apps.name: Mischka Golf
apps.short_description: Build, play and manage golf: design your own courses, play with friends locally or online and lead your own golf club to success – with staff, caddies, tournaments, cheering crowds, weather and seasons. Fully playable offline, online leagues are optional.

apps.name: MischkaSpace
apps.short_description: Lead your species from the Atomic Age to Transcendence: explore a random galaxy, colonize worlds, design ships, forge alliances and command real-time space battles – a turn-based 4X space strategy game.

apps.name: Miyuri's Devotion
apps.short_description:
A cohabitation / temple management / dating sim game 
Corrupt and seduce your fellow nuns as you fall into depravity yourself.
Cast spells, manage your temple and upgrade your abilities.
“cleanse” the faithful in the confession booth, get frisky with the other nuns, and give yourself to the goddess

apps.name: Modern Crisis
apps.short_description: Command modern armies in fast, brutal RTS warfare. Build your base, secure oil and iron, and crush your enemy with tanks, stealth fighters, warships and ballistic missiles. Two asymmetric factions, land-air-sea combat, online Steam multiplayer, and a full map editor.

apps.name: Monster Forest
apps.short_description: The ancient forest has been corrupted by void energy into a fleshy spawning ground of mutated beasts. Choose two exiles from different factions to form a pact, and wield two distinct card builds to fight your way out of the suffocating woodland depths!

apps.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
apps.short_description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

apps.name: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
apps.short_description: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too 😉

apps.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
apps.short_description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

apps.name: Mouse Chef: Dig Out
apps.short_description: Dig your way to freedom with a spoon. upgrade your tools, cook meals, and fight your way through prison in a prison escape adventure inspired by classic rubber hose cartoon style in 1930s.

apps.name: MURINO: The Fog Is Coming
apps.short_description:
You are a courier in endless Murino.
Deliver orders, survive the fog, descend into the sewers, and decide who you will serve in a city where reality itself has long since cracked.

apps.name: Music Producer Tycoon
apps.short_description: Music Producer Tycoon is a music industry simulation game where you write, produce, and release songs across decades. Use AI tools, manage your studio, collaborate with legends, and build your legacy from a garage to global fame.

apps.name: Myriad Auction
apps.short_description: Blind-bid an entire warehouse in a roguelike auction. Spend resources to uncover clues about what is really inside, sharpen the appraiser's estimate, then make the one call that matters: bid or pass? Win the lot, then crack it open item by item to find out whether you struck gold or got fleeced.

apps.name: Mystic 6
apps.short_description: A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. Along your journey, weapons, potions, skills, runes, and much more will shape every run.

apps.name: N in One 益智小游戏合集：2048、连连看、泡泡龙、消灭星星
apps.short_description: A quick break, with a little overtime for your brain. Enjoy 20 minigames, including 2048, tile matching, bubble popping, box pushing and mazes. Pick from four difficulty levels per game, learn with illustrated guides, and play offline with local autosaves. Supports eight interface languages.

apps.name: Near The Fear
apps.short_description: Lost in an unknown world, alone and desperate, you're driving towards the light. On an ever-shifting road, turn inwards and face your ancient enemy to find the freedom you crave.

apps.name: NEO DRONE: REVERSE
apps.short_description: NEO DRONE: REVERSE is a sci-fi arcade game where you reverse direction, dodge obstacles, and use shields to survive. Avoid moving and blinking hazards, beat your high score, and compete on the online leaderboard. The world moves forward. You move backward.

apps.name: Neural Repair
apps.short_description: ATTENTION OPERATOR: Congrats on volunteering to repair a dying AI! (You didn't volunteer.) Light every tile. Do not retrace your steps. In this puzzle roguelike, avoid traps, fog, and that red thing. Should your stability hit zero, all progress will be wiped. NEXUS thanks you for your sacrifice!

apps.name: NEVER LOOK BACK
apps.short_description:
Descend the infinite office staircase. The Darkness follows you. Squeeze the rubber duck to not be afraid. And never look back.
Psychological horror in a dreamcore aesthetic

apps.name: New World Trading Company
apps.short_description: Found a trading company in the age of sail. Start with one small ship and an empty cove, hunt pirates and smugglers on a realistic sea, and grow a mighty fleet and a thriving harbour town. A single-player naval strategy game where wind, waves and every broadside matter.

apps.name: Next Acre
apps.short_description: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.

apps.name: NGL Biathlon 2027
apps.short_description: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon sports simulator. Control an athlete on the course and at the shooting range, compete in individual and relay events, develop a multi-season career, create custom tournaments, or simulate races in broadcast mode.

apps.name: NII-058
apps.short_description: Winter, the nineties. You climb onto the roof of a shut-down research institute to strip its copper, and the rusted roof gives way. The doors are welded, the windows bricked up. Something walks in the dark. Find a way out before it finds you.

apps.name: No Brakes Club
apps.short_description: A retro multiplayer platformer for up to 10 players per round. Sprint, sabotage, and backstab your way through quickfire minigames where every round takes seconds to learn and one mistake to lose.

apps.name: No Way Back
apps.short_description: ”No Way Out” is a turn based strategy game with rogue-like and deck building elements. Player needs to defeat groups of enemies. Survive on a limited field by flexibly moving and building character’s build in the gaps between enemy attacks until you fall or defeat all enemies.

apps.name: Nobody: Three Kingdoms
apps.short_description:
《Nobody: Three Kingdoms 》 is a card-driven roguelike set in the twilight of the Han dynasty. You open your eyes as a foot soldier no one will ever name. You arrive carrying the knowledge of an entire modern world, and what it buys you on day one is nothing. 
So before anything else — stay alive.

apps.name: Noclip: Entity
apps.short_description: Escape the Backrooms, or become the thing everyone is escaping from. One player hunts, seven run: lock doors, swing crowbars and talk your way out of trouble (or into it) in a 1v7 asymmetrical horror party with proximity chat, where every level is new and the exit is never where you left it.

apps.name: Node Pit
apps.short_description: Launch catalysts in a Plinko‑style reactor, activate nodes, and build warp energy in this physics‑based roguelike. Use inheritance and card choices to grow powerful nodes!

apps.name: Northgate Dispatch
apps.short_description: You run the signal box on the night shift. Bring trains in, hold the late ones, and send them back out before the timetable buries you. Route one wrong and the line locks up. A keyboard-driven dispatch puzzle on an 80s green-CRT board.

apps.name: Noyan: Club Chairman
apps.short_description: In Noyan: Club Chairman, you’re the president, not the manager. Leave tactics to the coach; your job is to manage finances, lock down sponsors, and win over the fans. Remember: matches are played on the pitch, but the club’s future is won in the presidential office!

apps.name: Nuclear Reactor Simulator 3D
apps.short_description: Step inside a nuclear power station in a first-person industrial simulation. Explore the facility, use specialist tools, inspect equipment and interact with the machinery of a complex power plant. More systems and gameplay are in development.

apps.name: One More Rock
apps.short_description: Dig for treasures, uncover hidden dangers, and make every move count! Explore 30 mine floors, collect precious gems, and test your skills in Easy and Hard modes inspired by Minesweeper.

apps.name: Operation Pay-per-Love
apps.short_description: An adult, choice-driven visual novel set in Tokyo’s nightlife. Follow one of three women, investigate an exploitative industry, and decide whether your money and attention will protect her freedom—or purchase a deeper dependency.

apps.name: Orbital Abyss: Cipher Division
apps.short_description: Decipher interstellar transmissions encoded via substitution ciphers aboard Eremite Station. In this choice driven narrative, uncover secrets from planetary factions while conversing with crewmates to reveal their stories and troubles. The ripples of your choices may be felt throughout the galaxy.

apps.name: Orthodoxía
apps.short_description: A first-person action game where you play as a witch infiltrating a cult-controlled town. Use black magic and telekinesis to fight your way through enemies and uncover the dark secrets of the place.

apps.name: Oystrike
apps.short_description: Crack oysters. Match pearls. Chase the jackpot! OYSTRIKE is a juicy incremental game packed with crunchy shells, sparkling loot, and gold-raining wins. Upgrade your knife, build your pearl factory, and tempt your luck with cursed treasures. Just one more oyster…

apps.name: Paid Parking Simulator
apps.short_description: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

apps.name: Parabless
apps.short_description:
Explore life and spiritual warfare in Parabless card game.
Grounded in a biblical moral code and driven by artistic expression, every card represents a facet of existence in a broken world.

apps.name: PARRALYSIS
apps.short_description: You open your eyes in a surreal space, paralysed. The only thing you can do is to scarcely move your right arm, and scribble. Scribble in a notepad before you to move forward. Towards a goal you must reach, despite something horrific trying to reach you. Create the cure. You don't have much time.

apps.name: Path of Cultivation
apps.short_description: A xianxia action roguelite. Fight, pick one of three techniques per level-up and loot advanced techniques, gear and materials. In camp, break through realms, choose talents, study techniques, enhance gear and brew pills. A mortal martial artist founds a sect and breaks the seal on Heaven's Gate.

apps.name: PC Store Together
apps.short_description: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

apps.name: Peexel Casino
apps.short_description:
Peexel Casino is an MMO set in the Las Vegas universe.

Hit up the strip with your friends, raid giant casino bosses for loot, or watch your little guy gamble in the corner of your desktop while you work!

In Peexel Casino, there are no rules! (local laws still apply)

apps.name: Pegs & Sorcery
apps.short_description: Aim your orbs. Power your party. Build your deck. In this pachinko roguelike deckbuilder, bounce through pegs to earn mana, then unleash cards in turn-based battles. Combine heroes, cards, and upgrades as you choose your path through each run.

apps.name: Phantom Grind
apps.short_description: Phantom Grind is a minimalist pixel-art action RPG you can play entirely with a mouse. Click to fight monsters, earn XP and gold, upgrade four stats, and reach Level 30 to face the final boss.

apps.name: Pheles Rebirth
apps.short_description: Pheles Rebirth is an RPG where you play as Pheles, a fallen angel who rebelled against God, and lead two knights into battle. Make their choices for them and turn the tide with over 250 skills and abilities in total, plus Unleashed Thoughts, powerful effects triggered by conditions in combat.

apps.name: Pheromone Onsen: How a Loser Got Laid Nonstop Thanks to a Secret Hot Spring
apps.short_description: A linear adult visual novel about a hopeless virgin who discovers a secret hot spring that gives him irresistible pheromones. Enjoy four fully voiced heroines, animated adult scenes, and an escalating hot spring harem—with no routes or complicated choices.

apps.name: Picnic In The Zone
apps.short_description: Picnic In The Zone tells a story about survival in the Zone. A vast, desolate place filled with dangerous enemies, deadly anomalies and strange mutated entities. Unveil your epic journey through the Zone as you hopelessly try to find your lost family.

apps.name: pipsquad
apps.short_description: Explore 108 hero classes and shape their dice in a turn-based roguelike. Read enemy intentions, keep key rolls, and combine attacks, shields, spells, and relics. Try custom parties, generated heroes, and ten-hero Raid battles.

apps.name: Pistol Cat
apps.short_description: Like Animal Crossing but really stupid and physics based. You are a heavily armed cat exploring a cozy yet chaotic open world island town. Discover items that give you abilities, get rich, collect custom costumes & accessories, farm, complete quests for your neighbors, unlock upgrades, and more!

apps.name: Pixish
apps.short_description: In Pixish anything can be a fish, it just takes your imagination and some png files. Use the in-game editor to create fish, objects to place, and even the food for your new desktop fish.

apps.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED
apps.short_description: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature — listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

apps.name: Please, Come Inside
apps.short_description: Horny apocalypse is here. Run the last tavern where seductive succubi hide among innocent beauties. Inspect guests intimately to unmask demons before they drain you dry! A dark fantasy survival sim.

apps.name: Please, Take The Phone
apps.short_description: Welcome to Jiabao Tower Property Management.The night shift has begun. Your job is simple: answer calls, check the manual, and fill out the forms. When the night feels slow, watch some TV—though the programs may seem strange.Remember: serve every resident well. Jiabao Tower is our home forever.

apps.name: Pocket TD
apps.short_description: A tower defense game on a map that grows as you play. Build from 12 towers, survive five biomes and their bosses, and pick perks that change each run.

apps.name: Poly Speed
apps.short_description: Poly Speed is a Low Poly racing game with an open world. You can play races against your friends or AI's. You can try to get the World Record in one of the races. Or build your own races to play with your friends.

apps.name: PomoIdle Arena
apps.short_description: A Pomodoro timer × idle × command-battle RPG. Resources build up while you work — pull commands, power up your party, and battle other players between sessions. Your focused time becomes your strength.

apps.name: Poof!
apps.short_description: Battle your way off planet Omega-326. Play as Skelly or one of the other recruits to craft builds, solve puzzle and fight through waves of mutated creatures to survive.

apps.name: Potion Arena
apps.short_description: Build a five-slot potion loadout and fight real-time 1v1 duels. Your warrior attacks automatically; you decide when to heal, buff, or weaken your opponent. Hunt for gear, refine your strategy, and climb the leagues in this desktop PvP RPG.

apps.name: Princessfall
apps.short_description: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

apps.name: Prison Chef Simulator
apps.short_description: Step behind the counter of a high-security prison cafeteria. Prepare daily meals, manage scarce ingredients, and survive volatile inmates who throw trays at your face. Keep the dining hall from rioting and guard your cutlery, or your shift might be your last in this tense kitchen sim.

apps.name: Projekt Z: Beyond Order
apps.short_description: Battle the undead in this thrilling First-Person Zombie Shooter with robust character progression and weapon customization. Set around World War II, take on fast-paced missions as one of four survivors, each with their own unique abilities and role in Co-Op.

apps.name: PURLOIN
apps.short_description: PURLOIN! Steal in darkness to build in light. Cozy co-op horror.

apps.name: PWC Simulator
apps.short_description: PWC Simulator is a personal watercraft simulator with singleplayer practice, freestyle, online racing, and mod support.

apps.name: Quarter Note Cafe
apps.short_description: Act as Charithy, serving coffee to cultists, instruments and the regular passerby from your coffee shop in a city filled with all sorts of weird, kind and potentially dangerous people.

apps.name: Raceway Sparks
apps.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

apps.name: Ragnarok - Rise of the Nine Realms
apps.short_description: Build a Viking settlement, explore the Nine Realms and bargain with the gods. Rebuild from a camp in each new world, then carry your discoveries and permanent legacy through Ragnarök into another age. An offline single-player incremental game of resources, expeditions and rebirth.

apps.name: Raiding Season
apps.short_description: Lead a band of Viking raiders in search of wealth and glory in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit warriors, customize their abilities, and battle across deadly hex-based maps. Burn, plunder, and press onward for greater riches but rising enemy resistance could cost you everything you’ve gained.

apps.name: Railway End
apps.short_description: This is a hidden object puzzle game with a railway theme. Compare photos and correct differences in the scene, interspersed with a few puzzles. There is no text in the game.

apps.name: RareIcon
apps.short_description:
Rareicon is a fast-paced 2D sci-fi Action-RPG bullet-hell roguelite set in a collapsing digital dystopia.
Play as Chip, a debt-ridden survivor with WASD + mouse controls, building a sanctuary, upgrading gear, and recruiting allies to fight back against the DaemonCorps, robots, creatures and more!

apps.name: Ravenhill: Initiation
apps.short_description: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.

apps.name: RaviWar 1 : A Perfect Sonday
apps.short_description: A free first-person adventure of puzzles and precarious jumps. It is 2077. The world lives inside Takarek, a tower of 17,769 floors, and Consensus has decided what everyone in it thinks for forty years. You are twenty, new to the job of deprecating data. Tonight you keep one file to save the world.

apps.name: REBELLIOUN!
apps.short_description: You are a humble blacksmith with a dark secret, living in a small village under an occupying gang. The wheele chooses, the women serve, and the SEX carries on whether you're there or not! Rally a REBELLIOUN, and keep thy wife and daughter safe... if thou canst! An NTR village sandbox game.

apps.name: Red Ledger
apps.short_description: Four departments. One sealed warehouse. Submit your secret budget, claim the assets, and hope the paperwork survives inspection. Red Ledger is a short 4-player PvP bluffing game with bot-filled seats.

apps.name: Reef Royale
apps.short_description: A fast-paced battle royale for fish. Pick one of 30 fish, eat to grow, and bump everyone else out of a shrinking reef. Sharks, nets and whirlpools join in. Last fish wins.

apps.name: Resupply
apps.short_description: Your towers have limited ammo, and it's your job to deliver it. Resupply is a tower defence game where logistics is the real challenge. Move ammunition with workers, conveyor belts and autonomous bots, and keep your defence supplied as the waves get harder.

apps.name: Resurface
apps.short_description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore as your strength grows to crazy proportions, but don’t run out of oxygen!

apps.name: Rexaura
apps.short_description: Rexaura is a modification for Valve's Portal containing a new 20-chamber campaign centered around high energy pellets and many new testing elements. It is recommended for players who are familiar with Portal but want an extra challenge.

apps.name: Rey: Shattered Darkness
apps.short_description: A dark pixel-art action platformer set in a world shattered across time. Block, parry and cut your way through broken eras, cleanse the corruption spreading through them, and find your way home.

apps.name: RiftForged
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy multiplayer action RPG. Hunt monsters across deformable terrain, harvest their parts, and craft gear from what you kill. Dig a pit, use the pit. The physics hold it, and the monsters navigate around it. The world holds every mark you leave.

apps.name: Riftscourge
apps.short_description: Protect the land from the invading Demon Army in this action-packed couch co-op, hack n' slash with a rogue-like progression system.

apps.name: RIGUP
apps.short_description: Bolt together turrets from scavenged junk and hold a shattered city gate with up to 8 friends. RIGUP is a chaotic co-op first-person tower defense where heavy parts take two to carry, turrets break mid-fight, and one bad throw can knock your buddy out cold.

apps.name: Ritual : House Sitting
apps.short_description: A young woman named Nina accepts a house-sitting job recommended by a friend, tempted by the unusually generous pay. But is the house really as ordinary as it seems?

apps.name: Rivergrain Vale
apps.short_description: You bought an old farm to escape the noise of the city — but it's not that simple. The place is in ruins, and the workers have walked out. Roll up your sleeves, win them back one by one, and learn the farming life alongside your charming farmhands.

apps.name: Rocks Tools Hordes
apps.short_description:
Rocks, Tools, Hordes is a survival crafting game where a brave little girl explores vast caves, builds her base, and battles endless zombie waves. 
Play the Demo! Add to Wishlist!
Mine resources, craft gear, and pilot powerful robots to withstand the horde. Robots, rocks, and really rude zombies.

apps.name: Rogue Den
apps.short_description: Run businesses on the surface, build a criminal den below, recruit a crew, manage production and resources, deal with factions and trouble, and explore dangerous canals in search of a lost crown while keeping your boss paid.

apps.name: Rogue Dungeon 2
apps.short_description: The sequel to the solo dungeon crawler based on the board game. Step out of the dungeon and into Ilderia: travel a dangerous world, gather a party, follow questlines to a hard-won ending, and delve into flooded sewers, cursed tombs and a vampire-haunted castle.

apps.name: Roll N' Rage
apps.short_description: A difficult physics-based platforming game about a golf ball's journey home. Roll, fall, rage, repeat... or quit. It's up to you.

apps.name: Romance of Fangs: Part 1
apps.short_description: Humans and vampires must learn to coexist in harmony... could one vampire save them all? Help Brynn find true romance, navigate ancient traditions, and save the city in this choice-driven narrative adventure.

apps.name: Roots and Runes
apps.short_description: Roots & Runes is an RPG that combines a cozy homesteading atmosphere with a touch of adventure. In this game, you can build, decorate, farm, craft, fish and sell, or you can explore the world in engaging adventures, learn magic and take it home with you.

apps.name: rov
apps.short_description: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!

apps.name: Rox Solid Pro Football
apps.short_description: Choose your role (Owner, General Manager, Head Coach, Off/Def/ST Coordinator, or Position Coach), choose what you want to control (24 different settings across Scouting, Coaching, Front Office, and Game Management groupings), and play as many seasons as you want.

apps.name: Sagventyr
apps.short_description: This action game incorporates elements unique to the medium—such as the spirit of exploration as you venture into the unknown, the tension of weighing the risks and rewards of combat, and the exhilaration of acquiring rare, hard-to-find items.

apps.name: Sakura Arms ~Radiant Duels~
apps.short_description: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponent’s tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides’ selections.

apps.name: Saturn 9
apps.short_description: A short sci-fi horror adventure. All contact with the Saturn 9 has been lost, and you’re sent aboard to find out why. Explore the silent ship, solve its puzzles and uncover what happened to the crew.

apps.name: SCP - Containment Breach Revival
apps.short_description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

apps.name: SCRAP CROWN
apps.short_description: Rip their weapons off. Bolt them on. Take the crown. A voxel roguelite auto-battler where you choose fights for the parts you can salvage. Build a ridiculous scrap squad, set up powerful combos, and watch your plan play out.

apps.name: Sea of Pirates
apps.short_description: Command your own ship in a shared open sea. Hunt sea monsters and admirals, sink rival captains, conquer islands with your guild and sail into new Battle Pass seasons and seasonal events.

apps.name: Sea of Remnants
apps.short_description: Sea of Remnants is a visually rich ocean adventure RPG. As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make.

apps.name: Second Temple
apps.short_description: Journey through the Second Temple in Jerusalem in 65 AD as a priest, pilgrim or shopkeeper, or roam as you please

apps.name: Seeking My Fate: Medieval Fantasy
apps.short_description: Shape your fate and live your life. Can you survive in this fantasy world? Can you use the power in your blood? Will luck smile on you? There is one way to learn!

apps.name: Separator
apps.short_description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

apps.name: SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life
apps.short_description: "SEVEN DAYS: Strange Locked-Room Life" is a suspenseful escape-room visual novel. You are a reporter trapped with a drug company heiress for seven days. Can you survive the mastermind’s orders, uncover the truth, and escape before you lose your mind?

apps.name: Shav : The Night Watch
apps.short_description: An overnight job. A covered body. A lamp you must keep alight. Watch over a dead woman in a remote Indian village, and discover what's gone wrong before you open the door.

apps.name: Shawarma Karma
apps.short_description: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?

apps.name: Sheepscape
apps.short_description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

apps.name: SHORE
apps.short_description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

apps.name: Sickness Says
apps.short_description: Nothing's Missing is a competitive multiplayer game where you rob each other's houses, handcraft ridiculous counterfeits, and try to uncover what your opponents stole. Memorize your belongings, build convincing fakes, and call the cops when something looks suspicious.

apps.name: Sigma Survivor
apps.short_description: Sigma Survivor is a roguelike type game. Lead your hero and survive the whole round while enemies of every kind cross your path. Grab power-ups, take risks, play MINIGAMES, upgrade your character, and come back stronger with every run!

apps.name: Silent Observer
apps.short_description: Every floor is a new world. A first-person psychological horror where every floor is a new nightmare. Travel through chilling environments, unravel disturbing stories as the elevator takes you deeper and deeper into the unknown. Can you make it to the last floor?

apps.name: Simutales
apps.short_description: An open-world life sim! ✦ ݁˖ Build your dream town, reveal the mysteries of your neighbours, and live your best (or worst) life.

apps.name: Sinful Survivors
apps.short_description: A Vampire Survivors-style survival action game. 🎮 Includes 30+ voiced 🗣️ and animated ✨ scenes! 💦 😈Three sinful heroines work hard to survive!🔥Command the seductive Succubus 💋, the motherly Slime 🟢, and the devout Priestess🙏as they battle massive armies surging in from all directions! ⚔️

apps.name: SketchBrawl
apps.short_description: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.

apps.name: Skill Issue
apps.short_description: Skill Issue is a collection of competitive minigames where you can outplay the competition through pure mechanical skill-master.

apps.name: SkullWar:ProvingGrounds
apps.short_description: SkullWar: Proving Grounds is a cold sci-fi tactical strategy game. Control humanoid war machines known as "Skulls" in turn-based hex-grid ranged combat. Act 2 out of 3 actions (Move, Attack, or Function) per turn, with full enemy visibility. Victory lies in resource planning and squad synergy.

apps.name: SLAPPED SILLY
apps.short_description: A game of tag with terrible manners. Chase, dodge, and slap your friends through a living 3D newspaper in this party game for up to 12 players. Get slapped and join the chase, dress to impress, and turn your finest moments—and worst falls—into front-page news.

apps.name: Slay the Tire
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder on two wheels. Ride four outlaws down the world's great roads, from Monument Valley to the Tokaido, the Scottish Highlands and the pyramids of Giza, and fight every car, truck and creature that wants you off the road, one card at a time.

apps.name: SLENDYJAN
apps.short_description: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

apps.name: Slime Splitter
apps.short_description: A pixel art incremental game about popping slimes. Sweep your jelly ring across the arena and split every slime into smaller pieces until the screen overflows, then spend the jelly on a huge skill tree and card deck to push past 15 bosses and into endless mode.

apps.name: Slop Squad
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Vacuum up valuable scrap from procedurally generated maps and get it back to the scrap crusher before the things lurking inside get you.

apps.name: Sly Crow
apps.short_description: A humorous 2D point-and-click adventure in a bright post-zombie world. Play as Zoti, a sarcastic zombie farm girl, and chase a crow who stole your dad’s brain - with a goose sidekick who helps… loudly.

apps.name: Snack Attack
apps.short_description:
Something's wrong on aisle 5. The products have woken up. The expiry date is close. Nobody's getting out clean.
Snack Attack is a fast, chaotic party game for you and your friends, grab what you can, before someone grabs you.

apps.name: Solbreak Skirmish
apps.short_description: Solbreak Skirmish is a fast-paced tactical 1v1 battle with RTS-like mechanics. Control your units, each with a unique ability, to help turn the tide of battle in your favor! With multiple win conditions, there's plenty of room for skill expression and creativity to take down your opponent.

apps.name: Solmallow
apps.short_description: A cozy storybook adventure on islands of living felt. Wake beside a giant needle, stitch torn islands back together, gather and forge tools with friendly masters, calm grumpy Sprouts and find out who unravelled the world — and why.

apps.name: SOMIA
apps.short_description: Somia is a psychological horror game in which you follow a young woman who discovers she is trapped in a loop after finding a cursed doll.

apps.name: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run!
apps.short_description: Your microphone is your weapon! Play online with up to 8 players, scream to attack, kick your friends, dodge your rivals, and unleash chaos with ridiculous power-ups and unpredictable matches. Grab your mic and let out your best Sooooooooooo!

apps.name: sorry
apps.short_description: Navigate a chilling dungeon of psychological torment in this retro 2D horror game. Try to escape. You are not alone. The faster you run, the faster the relentless enemy catches up. Your heart is pounding, and it's closer with every heartbeat. The end is near...

apps.name: Sort It Together
apps.short_description: PLAY FOR FREE WITH FRIENDS! Clean, sort, and restore messy places together. Enjoy a relaxing tidy-up experience or turn up the chaos! Take on jobs, earn money, and build your own cleaning business. Just leave every place cleaner than you found it. How hard could that be?

apps.name: Soup N' Shots
apps.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world, restore a forgotten farm with your friends. By day, grow crops, explore the wasteland, and uncover its secrets. By night, defend it from dark creatures with live music, a powerful arsenal, and revitalizing soup. Can you survive until dawn?

apps.name: Soviet Backrooms
apps.short_description: Soviet Backrooms is a first-person survival horror set in abandoned Soviet apartment blocks. Explore decaying apartments, stairwells, and endless corridors, search for a way out, and listen for the footsteps of something you cannot see.

apps.name: Space Builder Idle
apps.short_description: Start with a small furnace and build your space base, one module at a time. Hire workers, automate production, build an Artificial Sun and assemble your own ship. Use Prestige to start again with permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Spin Ball 3D Puzzle
apps.short_description: Move blocks and build paths to guide each colorful ball to its matching flag in 400 handcrafted 3D logic puzzles. Relax, think and solve increasingly challenging levels.

apps.name: Spin of the Demon Realm
apps.short_description:
A new adventure begins for SPIN, a girl from the Demon Realm.

Meet new friends, grow stronger, and explore the unfamiliar Human World.

SPIN's own story begins in a bright and cheerful fantasy adventure.

apps.name: Spirit of Europe - Enlightenment
apps.short_description: Guide the Spirit of Europe in a turn-based historical grand strategy game. Expand across 23 cities, unlock great thinkers, inspire their works, and shape the Enlightenment through ideas, reform, and institutions.

apps.name: Spreadsheet Tower Defense
apps.short_description: Spreadsheet TD is a tower defense game set in a spreadsheet. Build a maze of formula towers, then invest in stronger defenses or save for the next round. Draft new tower cards as you play and research more options for future runs. No Excel required.

apps.name: STADAREN - Stockholm Night Shift
apps.short_description: You are a night cleaner in Stockholm. While the rest of the city sleeps, you and a few others work to keep it running. It’s a quiet, routine job - until you step into the empty corporate corridors and uncover something you could never have imagined.

apps.name: STARFADE
apps.short_description: Command fleets across whole star systems in real time. Hold the warp gates, cut the enemy's supply lines, launch your carriers' wings and tear open a rift to jump a titan behind their lines. Three factions, three story campaigns, and wars from 1v1 duels to sector-wide conquest.

apps.name: STARFADE: Sortie
apps.short_description: Strap into a Lancer frigate in the middle of a war between fleets. Launch off a 900 m supercarrier, lock targets with a glance, break an Edict's lance before it fires and cripple a 7 km worldship. A VR space combat game you can also play on a flat screen.

apps.name: Stash Mayhem
apps.short_description: Run a medieval-fantasy warehouse in this roguelike for 1 to 4 players online. Sort the goods your way while it's calm, survive the rush of impatient customers and upgrade it every night. The only map is in your head. Know where everything is, or just embrace the mayhem.

apps.name: Steadfast
apps.short_description: Command large fleets in Steadfast, a real-time naval tactics game set in the Age of Sail. Master wind and weather, maneuver historic warships, unleash devastating broadsides, board enemy vessels, and break the enemy line in battle!

apps.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
apps.short_description: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.

apps.name: StickType
apps.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

apps.name: Stingray Sanctuary
apps.short_description: Stingray Sanctuary is a cozy idle management game. Raise stingrays in real time, then stack creatures, plants, and curios into systems that earn and collect money for you. Start small, get rich, and let the island run while you're away, or keep it docked on your desktop as you work.

apps.name: Street Girls: Love Records
apps.short_description: Work odd jobs, pay the rent, and fall in love in a small Chinese city. This 2D romance visual novel mixes light life-sim elements with three heroines and nine endings. Balance money, time, and energy as casual texts and budget dates grow into relationships that are harder to leave behind.

apps.name: Subgloom
apps.short_description: A Metroidvania with roguelike elements where you explore an underground world and the terrain is destructible. Buy powerful guns to kill enemies, drones to fly around, bombs to destroy terrain, and explore hidden rooms.

apps.name: Suns Unknown
apps.short_description: After a failed test of an experimental warp drive, a lone survivor is stranded in an unknown star system. Keep your damaged ship running, recruit a crew, explore alien worlds, and find a way back home.

apps.name: Sunset Devils
apps.short_description:
Sunset Devils is a top-down action shooter, Where every weapon's unique controls must be mastered through the thrill of an old west gunfight. 
A classic spaghetti western story of vengeance, portrayed in stylish pixel art.

apps.name: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets
apps.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

apps.name: Super Woden GP 3
apps.short_description: Experience the ultimate arcade driving experience! Journey through motorsport history by collecting vehicles from every era and compete in rally, circuit racing, endurance racing, and many other disciplines as you climb to the top of motorsport in an extensive campaign mode.

apps.name: SUSHISNK
apps.short_description: Link your sushi and break through! Steer past enemies as your sushi auto-attack. Match three to upgrade plates, then mix Sushi Families and Specialties into your own Platter. Will the beckoning cat upgrade again? Giant seafood is on the way. Your next plate, your next big win awaits!

apps.name: SUSPECIES
apps.short_description: SUSPECIES is a multiplayer hide-and-seek party game for up to 12 players where aliens sculpt and paint themselves to blend into crowds. Hide from the friend hunting you, or take the stage in the SUSPECIES Show and sculpt against your friends or with your team. Don't be sus.

apps.name: Swarmhold
apps.short_description: A base-building action roguelite where the swarm never lets up. Drop into new terrain every run. Gather resources, build your defenses, draft upgrades mid-run, and fight alongside your base to hold the line. Solo or up to 4-player co-op.

apps.name: Swimcraft: Fishing Simulator
apps.short_description: Turn your favourite swims into virtual fishing venues in a cozy angling sim grounded in real watercraft. Snap any water, stock it with fish, tie authentic rigs, read the swim, and land the specimen of a lifetime. Your swim, crafted.

apps.name: SWIMSUIT ZOMBIES
apps.short_description: Gear up and prepare in this wave-based FPS! Battle against endless hordes of zombies wearing swimsuits. Upgrade your weapons and complete challenges to increase your odds of survival. Claim victory over the beachgoers by successfully defeating all rituals scattered throughout the maps!

apps.name: Syberia The World Before - Prologue
apps.short_description: Discover the prologue of the next instalment of Syberia: The World Before, which returns to the origins of the Syberia saga.

apps.name: Take or Tear
apps.short_description: Smash boxes. Keep the big prize in play! Contestants, will you take the check or tear it up and push your luck? Add traits to boxes and checks to profit from either choice. Face surprises and deals under my watchful eye. Build your prize pool and aim for a million in prize money!

apps.name: Tales of Soravos: Ashen Company
apps.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG inspired by tabletop games, with deep character customization, dynamic tile-based combat, reactive AI, and a branching narrative shaped by your choices. Create your free company and lead them through a world on the brink of war.

apps.name: Tales of Tonbrook
apps.short_description: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid.  When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it!  Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

apps.name: TamerTamer
apps.short_description:
Collect, raise, and fuse monsters...
Create the ultimate monster!
TamerTamer is a 2D roguelite action game where you recruit over 100 unique monsters, fuse them to create new ones, raise them, and form a battle party.

apps.name: Tank Battle: Kill Them
apps.short_description: A tank shooting simulation game. The protagonist works himself to death and lands in Hell. A demon hands him a tank. You control it, blast enemies, dodge attacks, and fight your way out of Hell back to reality. Simply put: pure shooting satisfaction!

apps.name: Tarzan VR
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Jungle!  Journey through the fantastic lands of Tarzan in a 3-part adventure created especially for virtual reality. Swing, swim, climb and fight your way across savage lands where the only limits are your own imagination.

apps.name: TBT : TaskBarTimber
apps.short_description: A little logging adventure beside your taskbar. Chop trees automatically while you work or browse, then spend your haul on skills, gear and new characters. Collect rare trees, craft stronger equipment and venture deeper into colorful pixel-art forests.

apps.name: Team Buddies
apps.short_description: A fast-paced action and strategy game where you build teams, craft weapons, and destroy enemy bases in intense online and campaign battles.

apps.name: That Probably Belongs in a Museum
apps.short_description:
That Probably Belongs in a Museum is a chill and cozy organizing game about cataloging and curating an enormous amount of ancient artifacts!
Your job is simple: Catalog ancient artifacts, uncover bizarre stories, and help build a collection of artifacts that probably belong in a Museum!

apps.name: The Aether Project TD
apps.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

apps.name: The Art Keeper
apps.short_description: Restore forgotten galleries, create art, decorate your space, and turn 3D sketches into physics objects in a puzzle sandbox—while uncovering the quiet mystery behind more than 400 paintings.

apps.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
apps.short_description: Help Jess to organize, repair and restore retro objects - cassettes, cartridges, cameras - while you solve riddles and puzzles hidden in an attic full of memories. A cozy story with hints of mystery where you'll unveil who Matt really was and who Destiny was.

apps.name: The Bitter End
apps.short_description: A sapphic narrative mystery and life sim. Manage your days aboard a liminal ship, navigating relationships both tense and tender. Fall in love, or bring your companions together. Join the crew, investigate your past, and find a way home.

apps.name: THE BOY'S WORD
apps.short_description: “The Boy's Word” is a visual novel about growing up in a Moscow suburb in the 2000s. Lena, 16, is pulled into the local courtyard crew, where friendship, first love and family secrets come at a price. 10 characters, 5 endings — your choices decide everything.

apps.name: The Endless Pit
apps.short_description: Build your own crazy vehicles, dive into an endless procedurally generated pit, and explore mysterious underground worlds! Collect valuable resources, upgrade your creations, and push deeper into the unknown. Extract your loot before it's too late — or risk losing everything!

apps.name: The Goddess's Will
apps.short_description: Dive into a 2.5D isometric action RPG adventure inspired by late-90s and early-00s classics. Face cunning enemy factions, explore a layered world filled with vivid characters, mythic stories, and handcrafted environments.
