Immerse yourself in a dangerous and unforgiving golden age of power fantasy.

apps.name: the Grand Butt-Sex Hotel
apps.short_description: After finding a new job as a bellboy for a suspicious hotel, you discover all of the guests are futa with incredibly specific tastes that you may resemble...

apps.name: The Grant Grover Anthology
apps.short_description: In Neo Naarm in the 22nd century, augmentation technology has run amok. Combining deduction, visual novel and point and click gameplay, play as Grant Grover, private detective, one of the only remaining citizens without augmentations, as he solves crimes across the city.

apps.name: The Iconoclast
apps.short_description: A sci-fi turn-based RPG and a homage to the great RPGs of the past, featuring an innovative battle system where you can fight with up to 6 of your party members at once. Plus several fully 3D animated PS1-style FMV cutscenes!

apps.name: The Last Gate
apps.short_description: Choose your heroine and fight through a world being erased. A dark fantasy action roguelite for 1-4 players: build your power with upgrade cards, push through chained rifts in Dive, or face growing hordes with automatic attacks in Survival.

apps.name: The Last Levee
apps.short_description: Raiders want your crew's dig, and they don't need to take it. They just need to break the dam. Hold the line in this first-person tower defense: build and power turrets, patch the gates under fire, and pump out the flood before the pit goes under.

apps.name: The Last Ores
apps.short_description: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

apps.name: The Liminal Cleaner - The Pools
apps.short_description: An atmospheric pixel-art cleaning game set in the Poolrooms. Explore abandoned pools and corridors, recover your tools, and scrub away grime using four cleaning methods. Watch the world change as you restore each area and uncover its secrets.

apps.name: The Lonely Golem
apps.short_description: A retro style fantasy adventure combining open world exploration with turn based combat. Travel the seven realms fighting your way through elemental dungeons as you search for a way to cure the enchanted forest from a poisonous blight...

apps.name: The Lootlands
apps.short_description: What if Path of Exile played itself? Build your hero, automate the grind, and collect god-tier loot. Even while you sleep.

apps.name: The One Who Stands Behind
apps.short_description: You are a God of Destruction. Realize your strength through powerfull card combos and burn your enemies from existence in the unique deckbuilder combined with hex-grid tactics.

apps.name: The Park Keeper
apps.short_description: Become a ranger in a national park where people have doubles. Check visitors, explore the forest, and help its strange inhabitants. A copy might be better than the original. But does that give it the right to take their place?

apps.name: The Planewalker's Guild
apps.short_description: Lead a guild of adventurers through the ruins of the Fallen Keep in this turn-based tactics roguelite. Recruit heroes, spend action points on brutal powers, and decide every step on the road to Blackstone. Every expedition ends in glory or a grave.

apps.name: The Returns Desk: A Cozy Library
apps.short_description: A cozy tidy-up game for VR. Put 864 books back where they belong in a Victorian rotunda library, by hand. Every cover tells you its wing, its row and its slot, and nothing sorts itself. Finished rows open new wings and bring back the weather and the hours of the day. No timers, no fail state.

apps.name: The Walking Trade 2
apps.short_description: Run a shop in an apocalyptic wasteland! Play alone or co-op (1-8 players) scavenging the wild new world, craft stock and upgrades, manage your workforce, and fend off undead hordes with your lives. Will you be heroes, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store and your fate.

apps.name: The Witch’s Errand
apps.short_description: A cozy hidden object adventure about Myrta, a kind but absent-minded witch, and her new assistant. Explore magical locations, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and save the Whispering Forest.

apps.name: The Wizard's Path
apps.short_description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

apps.name: Theathre of Maps
apps.short_description: Theatre of Maps is a virtual tabletop for running and playing RPG adventures. Hosted completely via Steam without servers, port-forwarding or subscriptions. Bring any map of VTT export and link multi-level worlds with dynamic fog of war, line of sight, turn based combat, shared journals & more!

apps.name: Thief Simulator 3
apps.short_description: The Thief is back! Play solo or team up in CO-OP as a duo of thieves, plan the perfect hits, or improvise when things go wrong. From pickpocket to crime boss – only the best gangs will make it to the top.

apps.name: This Is the Peace
apps.short_description: The Nobel committee said no. Take charge of a presidential crisis desk, dispatch a team of huge talents and bigger egos, negotiate global conflicts, and try not to start a war from your phone. A political satire about managing people, power, and your own mouth.

apps.name: Thothic
apps.short_description: Thothic is a logic puzzle game where you land stones on their glowing targets. But all stones move together, in the same direction — so you'll need to find the one path that brings every stone home at once.

apps.name: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
apps.short_description: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

apps.name: Three Married Ladies Only Obey Me
apps.short_description: Nico Wolf, an underdog journalist, meets three married women in real life after online dating. They are willing to submit to him to break free from their husbands' control, but unknown dangers are quietly approaching.

apps.name: Tongo
apps.short_description: Build a deck of powerful cards, manipulate probability, and break the rules of Bingo in this roguelike deckbuilder. Create insane combos, chase massive jackpots, and discover game-changing synergies in every run.

apps.name: Toon Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive seven rooms of the Night Parade. Pick 1 of 12 hand-drawn heroes, stack wild upgrades, drink the Elixir of Ascension to unleash every power at once, and break the bosses that guard each door. A cartoon survivors roguelite where the horde arrives in formation.

apps.name: TOP DOG TEXAS
apps.short_description: TOP DOG TEXAS is a dueling simulator for 1–5 players. To become the top dog of the neighborhood, stake your companions’ lives and fight with the cards you draw. On these streets, the nerve to bet matters just as much as your combat skills.

apps.name: Touch Grass, Pls!
apps.short_description: Touch Grass, Pls! is a tiny, relaxing meadow toy. Brush the grass with your mouse, watch it spring back, and earn delightfully unnecessary milestones. Settle into morning light, a golden sunset, or a night full of fireflies. Stay for a moment. The grass can wait.

apps.name: Touhou Chess
apps.short_description: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.

apps.name: Tower Hero Survival
apps.short_description: A tower-defense roguelite with automatic attacks. Choose from 60 towers and combine 95 weapons with 100 upgrades. Survive 30 waves or challenge other players online. Every run brings a new build. Whose tower will stand the longest?

apps.name: Town Hall
apps.short_description: The town is half empty, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk. Whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money. In the basement, a file explains why the town emptied.

apps.name: TRACE//5
apps.short_description: Explore an office swallowed by darkness with only a camera to guide you, photographing and reporting traces of spirits in this short psychological horror game. Use flash and night vision to uncover anomalies. But not every anomaly is something you should photograph.

apps.name: Trade or Threat
apps.short_description: Trade or Threat is a first-person shopkeeping and dungeon-crawling simulation where you sell goods by day and search for valuable loot after dark. Earn enough gold to repay your debt to the boss while balancing profit, danger, and the rules imposed on your shop.

apps.name: Train Party
apps.short_description: Ride a slow train home to Antarctica with up to three friends. Feed the hungry chicks you pick up along the way, soak in the hot spring, try on silly costumes and watch the world roll by. A calm, cozy co-op journey for 1–4 penguins, with a little mischief.

apps.name: Trasssh
apps.short_description: Turn everyday junk into an arsenal. TrashS is a survival action roguelite where you fight hordes, scavenge loot, and extract. Combine weapons and cards, wield keyboards, ladles, and batteries, then use your haul to craft gear and develop your hideout for the next run.

apps.name: TRYPAN
apps.short_description: TRYPAN - A exploration based survival horror FPS. Return to Stagmon, the city where your father disappeared. Fight intelligent enemies. Improvise and use limited resources to defeat them.

apps.name: TryTakeMe
apps.short_description: TryTakeMe is a game inside an infected computer. The virus Lilith takes 92% of your machine’s power and leaves you 8%. Six viruses, six voices, a terminal, and a constant struggle for control. Mistakes are expensive: a virus may stay forever. 🖥️🖤

apps.name: TURF FIGHT
apps.short_description: Command specials. Command throws. In a beat 'em up.

apps.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
apps.short_description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

apps.name: Underpond
apps.short_description: Delve into the depths of the amphibian afterlife, the eponymous UNDERPOND, in this procedurally generated, hand-drawn, frog-hopping roguelite.

apps.name: Unmixable Syrup
apps.short_description:
I wolf down a cold, lonely meal.
Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky.
The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir.
So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

apps.name: VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG
apps.short_description: VALHALLA ARCHIVE is a tactical fantasy CCG where matches are decided in 5 turns. Deploy a 20-card deck across front and back rows, master 3 unique win conditions, and conquer the roguelite 'Dimensional Corridor'. Harness unpredictable Mana Rifts and claim your place as the ultimate Archivist!

apps.name: Vamblo
apps.short_description: Choose from four classes, turn skill upgrades and loot into your own build, and break through enemy hordes in this single-player action RPG. Dodge a boss’s charge, shatter its exposed arm, and turn an opening into your next victory.

apps.name: Veil City
apps.short_description: Draft monsters. Sign the cursed, the gifted, and the frankly concerning. A gothic roguelike football manager where every player has struck a bargain — and the city always collects.

apps.name: Velistra: Failed State
apps.short_description: A repair sim set in Velistra, a small Balkan country, from the fall of the Eastern Bloc to the early 2000s. Take apart radios, tape decks and TVs, clean them, replace parts or make your own from junk. Some of what comes in is stolen. Some of it has something inside that shouldn't be there.

apps.name: Venus Vacation PRISM - DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme -
Vesper Vector
apps.short_description: Blast through space and fight on the ground in Vesper Vector, a sci-fi arcade shooter. Dodge projectiles, battle bosses, and upgrade your ship and equipment. Play solo offline or team up with a friend in online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Village in Bloom
apps.short_description: Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

apps.name: Villages™
apps.short_description: Villages™ is an Open-World Sandbox game that has rules to encourage People to make a complex society and economy.

apps.name: Void In The Darkness
apps.short_description: Here the enemy doesn't just fight — the enemy writes the rules. Mid-battle, the very laws of war are rewritten, and what was your advantage a moment ago becomes a trap. Summon your army, choose its ground, and turn those rules against the one who wrote them.

apps.name: Wail of Despair
apps.short_description: A lonely girl left unaccompanied is followed into the colorful tunnels of her local fast food play place.

apps.name: Wait, They Can Climb?!
apps.short_description: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

apps.name: Walk It Off
apps.short_description: Build a wobbly robot for your friend. Then they have to walk it. A physics party game for 1-4 players: stumble across factory courses, dodge stamping presses, shoot switches with your plasma popper, and drop junk in their way from your drone. Nothing is random. Every fall is somebody's fault.

apps.name: War of Avareon
apps.short_description: Conquer the lands of Avareon in a turn-based strategy game where battles are decided by preparation, not dice. Build an economy, field armies in which every unit has a counter, and recruit heroes with game-changing abilities. Join the free open beta now: campaign, skirmish and multiplayer.

apps.name: Warehouse Bots
apps.short_description: Control warehouse robot traffic with road signs and configurable traffic lights. Manage orders, build and expand your warehouse, and organize storage to keep deliveries moving. Solve traffic jams, upgrade equipment, and grow your operation through the campaign or in sandbox mode.

apps.name: Wars of Empire
apps.short_description: Build your empire from a handful of villagers in this 2D isometric RTS. Advance through four ages, command armies, construct fortifications and lay siege to enemy strongholds. Conquer rival civilizations or challenge other commanders in online multiplayer.

apps.name: We Are The Wall
apps.short_description: We Are The Wall is a city-builder / RTS where you lead a hardy dwarf settlement fighting to protect their mountain home. Train armies, gather vital resources, explore the surrounding lands, and defend the Heart of the Mountain at all costs. We Are The Wall!

apps.name: What Acts up
apps.short_description: What Acts up is a psychological realism narrative adventure about social anxiety. Make choices, act under time pressure, and interact with shifting windows as Lin Mo’s fear and self-doubt invade the desktop. Some choices cannot be made, and some words simply refuse to come out.

apps.name: Wheel Make It
apps.short_description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

apps.name: Wheelie King 9
apps.short_description:
Realistic motorbike tuning and online driving game

customize your bike 

paint and add decals(+add own textures from computer)

change parts, add turbos for easier wheelies and drifting

online moped galleries, like and dislike other bikes on gallery

apps.name: Whispers Of The Shadow
apps.short_description: After a report comes in about Detective Grace Lawson’s missing stepsister, Amy, two officers head to an abandoned house. When Grace arrives, she finds one of them dead and suddenly becomes trapped inside. But something else is waiting for her.

apps.name: Whisperwell
apps.short_description: Whisperwell is a first-person multiplayer social deduction game where cute cats hide deadly secrets. Complete missions, use role-specific abilities, and discuss and vote to expose the killers, or deceive the village and eliminate anyone who gets in your way.

apps.name: Who A Meme I?
apps.short_description: The King reads out an awkward situation, you answer with the perfect meme from your hand. Make the King laugh, climb from island to island and steal the crown. A 2-8 player online party game for friend groups. Note: prompts are currently in Turkish only.

apps.name: Wicknick
apps.short_description: A co-op heist for 1-4 thieves, online or on one screen. Break into Lowlight's vaults by the light of one lantern: hang it on the light-lock to crack the cage, carry the chest out two by two, then hold the lift while the alarm wakes the dark.

apps.name: Winter Batch
apps.short_description: December 1988, Czechoslovakia. Your uncle ended up behind bars. Winter Batch is a first-person life simulator where you survive the brutal countryside winter, distill illegal alcohol, and earn the money to get him out.

apps.name: World of Two Worlds
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric journey between worlds ✨ Having lost your memory, you set out on a path of self-discovery: transform into animals, explore philosophical parables, and seek a legendary artifact capable of bestowing true enlightenment and revealing every facet of the universe 🌿

apps.name: Zarya
apps.short_description: Zarya - a narrative simulator of a rural driver in a post-Soviet style. Deliver packages along country roads, assist the villagers, earn money, collect classic cars, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the homeland.

apps.name: Zili Diary escape against the witch
apps.short_description: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

apps.name: Zombie BBQ House
apps.short_description: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

apps.name: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
apps.short_description:
Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... 
AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!!
Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

apps.name: Zoollision
apps.short_description: Pick your angle. Line up the shot. Then watch a single bounce turn the whole match around. Zoollision is a zoo-themed party game where animal balls collide, race, and compete in team minigames. Bring your friends and see where the next unexpected hit takes you.

apps.name: [AFANTASIA]
apps.short_description: Guided by a mysterious voice called “Intrusion,” play as a boy who wakes with no memories and explore a strange yet beautiful town in search of fragments of his lost past. Uncover who you are, and decide who you will become, before your identity vanishes entirely.

apps.name: 【パパたび】パパさ、旅系インフルエンサーで食っていこうと思っているんだ。
apps.short_description: An unemployed dad and his college-student daughter set out to make a living as travel influencers. Puzzle out destinations from clues, pin them on the world map, and grow your channel with videos: geo-guessing meets streamer sim. Aim for one million followers, with 200+ history and geography trivia.

apps.name: おやすみ冒険隊-ボクと最後の夏休み-
apps.short_description:
懐かしくて温かくてちょっぴり切ない……
少年少女たちによる、ひと夏のジュブナイルRPG！

apps.name: めろんぱんさばいば～
apps.short_description: Fight slime hordes and heal with melon bread in this roguelite survival action game. Combine weapons, magic, and cards with auto-attacks and unique character skills to survive. Choose from 20 characters and brave stage hazards, from encroaching lava to slippery ice!

apps.name: ガロゥズストライフ
apps.short_description: 『ガロゥズストライフ』は、人間が異形の怪物に変わる事件の最中、超常の力を得た主人公の少年ガロゥと少女ハイマを中心に描くダークファンタジーRPGです。バトルやイベントシーンでは、鮮やかなドット絵のキャラクター達が賑やかに動きます。仲間を集め「ルラガルド」へ旅立ちましょう。

apps.name: デスクトップフレンズ
apps.short_description: A voice-chat companion who lives on your desktop. Talk with two childhood friends, cheeky Tsumugi and gentle Hiyori, who remember you, start conversations on their own, set timers and notes by voice, and keep you company while you work. Japanese only (voice, text and interface).

apps.name: プロやきゅう好きやねん！プロ野球チーム経営シミュレーション－ボールパーク・チャンピオンズ－
apps.short_description: A Japanese baseball club management simulation. Take over a struggling ballclub, develop players, sign talent from overseas, and invest in your stadium as every decision shapes its future. Rich club dramas unfold along the way — winning isn't the only path to greatness.

apps.name: レフィシア：ザ・ワンダーログ ～ぐるぐる☆不思議の3日間～
apps.short_description:
Adapt your strategy to every drop and evolve your mastery. A nostalgic 2.5D action RPG where skills — not levels — define your power.
Train weapons and magic to forge unique builds and discover lethal synergies, all while facing the ultimate trial at the end of a 3-day journey.

apps.name: 九幽卷
apps.short_description: An ink-wash roguelike deckbuilder with five modes: a 20-floor run, a story mode, Challenge, a Daily Arena and the brand-new Duel, where both sides plan three moves in secret and guess where the other will play. Your enemies play cards too. Five heroes, 454 cards to build with.

apps.name: 僕の彼女とヤッてみる?
apps.short_description: Convince your girlfriend to bang your buddy in this NTR simulator! Will Akitoshi be able to get his girlfriend Minatsu hooked on his peculiar kink?

apps.name: 只开宝箱
apps.short_description: "Only Love Opening Chests" is an incremental casual game, player will use a wide variety of weapons to destroy uniquely styled treasure chests, experiencing the rhythm shifting from slow beginnings to intense excitement, as well as the sense of accomplishment from growing stronger step by step

apps.name: 嘿 爱幽 HEY AIYOE
apps.short_description:
The official spin-off game of the romance sim Aiyoe's Secret Room is here!
Version 1.0 includes five girls, each with her own three-stage transformation!
It reacts to your input, and an achievement system plus hidden forms are waiting for you to unlock!

apps.name: 基因織女 Gene Weaver
apps.short_description:
Enter the smallest scale.
Re-weave life’s narrative at a molecular level.
Freely explore the genetic universe for superpower genes.
Create your own magic carpet!

apps.name: 她的臭脚
apps.short_description:
Scorching summer, a Night Parade of One Hundred Demons,Yuri, and the stinky feet of a beautiful girl!
You will play as a giantess, stomping the yokai to death with your stinky feet that have been suffocating in boots and pantyhose all day long.

日语

apps.name: 守城录：六阵 — 三国卡牌构筑塔防
apps.short_description: Hex-grid tower defense set in the Three Kingdoms. Build your deck, summon legendary heroes, and hold the last stronghold through 20 waves of endless night.

apps.name: 安平 An-pêng
apps.short_description: After the air raid, everyone in Anping evacuated inland. You didn't. A ten-floor apartment with no power, someone who couldn't be bothered to leave, and a fridge of food gone bad. Cards decide where the time goes: search, move, eat, sleep. No base to hold, no breaking out. Just one more day.

apps.name: 射击派对
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer shooter where losing makes you stronger. Stack crazy skill cards, create broken builds, and fight your friends in unpredictable battles.

apps.name: 少牌マイティ
apps.short_description:
Still playing mahjong with 13 tiles?
Mighty Mahjong is a next-gen twist where you start one tile short — and that missing tile becomes a wild card! Outsmart opponents with bold strategy and sharp reads. Anime-style online battles, special rules, team modes, and fast-paced matches. Free to play!

apps.name: 幻想进度条 Fantasy Bar
apps.short_description: Fantasy Progress Bar is a medieval fantasy idle mobile game. Enjoy effortless AFK and free class switching, alongside mythical beast nurturing, equipment forging and mount exploration. You don’t need to keep your screen on — progress continues even offline.

apps.name: 挂机练功房
apps.short_description: A cozy idle RPG starring a pink-haired swordmaiden who fights and grows on autopilot. Befriend a cast of charming NPC girls, collect gorgeous CG artwork, defeat floor guardians and climb ever-higher floors.

apps.name: 时光餐厅
apps.short_description: 《时光餐厅》是一款轻松休闲的餐厅经营游戏。你将从一家小餐馆开始，安排厨师做菜、服务员上菜，接待不断到来的顾客。随着生意越来越好，你可以扩展餐厅规模、解锁更多菜品，让自己的餐厅变得越来越热闹。

apps.name: 桌面蚂蚁
apps.short_description: Build your own ant nest on the computer desktop, placing food and items. Ants will forage, gather, and carry food. Use different foods and objects to trick them, and later you'll encounter various insects or other ants that you'll need to battle.

apps.name: 梁山叠义
apps.short_description: Build a Liangshan stronghold in this solo card-stacking survival and management game inspired by Water Margin. Gather, cook, craft and connect transport routes to automate production. Recruit legendary outlaws, equip your band and command pausable real-time card battles.

apps.name: 沙海王国
apps.short_description: Build an oasis city in a hand-painted desert. Manage resources, defend your walls, and conquer bandit kingdoms. Trade supplies with friends, capture and raise dragons, command their attacks, and soar with them above the battlefield.

apps.name: 灵田修仙：炼丹模拟器
apps.short_description: **Cultivation: Alchemy Simulator** blends Chinese fantasy, incremental growth, management, and light roguelite elements. Grow spiritual herbs, refine pills, recover lost formulas, cultivate techniques, befriend fellow cultivators, and ascend toward immortality.

apps.name: 熊猫武者：余烬
apps.short_description: Pandrior emberwake is a  action game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. In a world where humanity is extinct, face off against mutated creatures and mechanical legions. Amidst the cold, steel slaughter, carve a path to survival in this ruined world.
developers: 杭州短尾猴视觉科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州短尾猴视觉科技有限公司

apps.name: 猫咪小窝
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop cat companion. Decorate a little home, prepare meals, tidy the litter box, and pause for a pet. Collect daily fur drops to unlock furniture and room colors, then watch your cat wander between the rooms you create.

apps.name: 猫猫放置
apps.short_description: MiaoMiao Idle is a healing-style cat-themed idle game. In the peaceful "Cat Village", you live alongside adorable cats — gathering, fishing, farming, mining, raising cats, building, and crafting equipment, enjoying a laid-back countryside cat life.

apps.name: 王国之盾
apps.short_description: "The Shield of The Kingdom" is a defense strategy game where player needs to protect their realm from enemies. Within the game, player controls 3 heroes and command troops in battle to repel invasions. Effective hero combinations and masterful tactical control are keys to achieving ultimate victory!

apps.name: 発情エクスタシー
apps.short_description: In this game, you'll give massages to girls currently in heat. As a staff member at a massage parlor, your goal is to fulfill the requests of visiting girls and leave them thoroughly satisfied. Four unique characters are eagerly waiting for your touch!

apps.name: 盲拍大亨：黑市货柜
apps.short_description: Bid on a cargo lot with only clues and rival offers to guide you. Scratch to reveal the goods one by one; a quick reveal leaves closed boxes and trays for you to open. Keep a find, sell the rest, and follow the real leftovers when a rival takes the lot.

apps.name: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the FlowerCape
apps.short_description: "The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape"is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

apps.name: 花札ノ巫孤 / Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda
apps.short_description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

apps.name: 要下海吗？（Could you be my onlyfans?）
apps.short_description: As a former corporate drone who received a severance package, you happened to make 30 million in one fell swoop through FX—and then stumbled upon a new streamer named Asuka. Faced with an invitation from this inexperienced but enthusiastic streamer, what will you choose?

apps.name: 記憶力最強エレベーター！？
apps.short_description: Observe on the move. Survive by memory. Which floor was that bird on? Memorize the birds and climb to your absolute limit!
developers: インフィニットクリエイト
publishers: インフィニットクリエイト

apps.name: 财富大爆炸
apps.short_description: 财富大爆炸是一款以财富积累为核心的数值成长类游戏。你需要通过解锁与升级资产、选择策略、掌握宇宙、创世模拟等机制不断财富突破上限，体验从起步到指数级膨胀的爽感。适合喜欢放置、点击与长期养成的玩家。

apps.name: 超魔球！ホームランダービー
apps.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

apps.name: 辞职修仙传
